headline: Select Medical goes private in $3.9 billion insider-led buyout
summary: A consortium led by Select Medical's own executive chairman alongside private equity firm Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe completed a take-private deal valuing the specialty hospital operator at about $3.9 billion, delisting it from the NYSE.

headline: FDA clears AI tool that spots hidden heart disease from routine ECGs
summary: Pathway Labs' EchoNext became the first AI system cleared to flag structural heart conditions like heart failure and valve disease directly from a standard 12-lead ECG, reportedly outperforming cardiologists in large-scale validation testing.

headline: Pearl Health raises $110 million to expand Medicare AI platform
summary: The value-based care technology company closed a $50 million Series C led by Andreessen Horowitz plus a $60 million credit facility, funding it will use to grow its AI-driven risk and workflow tools for providers managing Medicare patients.

headline: Mayo Clinic's longtime CEO to depart at year's end
summary: Dr. Gianrico Farrugia announced he will step down as Mayo Clinic's president and CEO by the end of 2026 after leading the health system since 2019, with a successor expected to be named in November.

headline: Asia-Pacific digital health investment splits sharply toward infrastructure over startups
summary: Analysis of first-quarter 2026 deal flow found roughly $2.65 billion in strategic digital health investment across Asia-Pacific compared to just $244 million in traditional venture funding, signaling investors are prioritizing healthcare data and AI infrastructure over early-stage startups.

headline: Malaysian insurtech PolicyStreet tops up Series C to $26 million with impact investor BlueOrchard
summary: Southeast Asian insurtech PolicyStreet added $5 million more to its Series C round, bringing the total to $26 million, with new backing from impact investor BlueOrchard to fund regional expansion into mobility, travel and gig-economy insurance.

headline: Employee-benefits insurtech Plum raises ₹193 crore after turning profitable
summary: Indian B2B health-benefits platform Plum raised about $20.6 million in a Series B led by Peak XV Partners, nearly doubling its valuation, to invest in AI-driven claims operations and deepen HR and payroll integrations.

headline: MSIG Asia recruits QBE veteran Ronak Shah to lead its regional business
summary: Singapore-based insurer MSIG Asia named Ronak Shah, formerly CEO of QBE's Wholesale Markets Asia, as its new Regional CEO effective October 2026, giving him oversight of operations spanning Southeast Asia, Hong Kong, India, Oceania and Greater China.

headline: Brussels issues draft guidance on which insurance AI systems count as high-risk
summary: The European Commission released draft, non-binding guidelines clarifying when AI systems used in insurance underwriting and pricing fall under the EU AI Act's high-risk regime, ahead of an August 2026 compliance deadline for such systems.

headline: Big asset managers post solid June AUM gains as markets climb
summary: Invesco disclosed preliminary assets under management of about $2.47 trillion at the end of June 2026, up nearly 1% month over month, as peers including AllianceBernstein and Artisan Partners also reported higher managed assets heading into second-quarter earnings.

headline: MetLife signals softer alternative-investment returns for the second quarter
summary: MetLife issued a preliminary estimate putting second-quarter 2026 variable investment income - largely returns from private equity and real estate funds - well below its full-year guidance pace, a cautious signal for insurers' alternative asset portfolios.

headline: US annuity sales cross $100 billion for a tenth straight quarter
summary: LIMRA reported total US annuity sales of roughly $107 billion in the first quarter of 2026, extending an unprecedented streak of quarterly sales above the $100 billion mark and reinforcing forecasts that full-year 2026 volume will stay above $450 billion.

headline: Corebridge and Equitable combine in $22 billion deal to build a $1.5 trillion retirement giant
summary: Corebridge Financial and Equitable Holdings agreed to an all-stock merger that would create the largest annuity seller in the country by volume, serving more than 12 million customers with a combined $1.5 trillion in assets once the deal closes by year-end 2026.

headline: India forces life insurers onto new accounting standard, upending reported earnings
summary: IRDAI's board approved changes requiring life insurers to switch to Ind AS-based financial statements starting April 2026, a shift expected to significantly alter how carriers recognize and disclose profits and reserves.

headline: Asset-intensive reinsurance keeps expanding across Asia-Pacific life insurance
summary: Insurers in the region are increasingly using asset-intensive reinsurance and sidecar structures to manage capital under new solvency regimes taking effect in 2026, a trend that is now drawing closer regulatory scrutiny over concentration risk.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance notches second-biggest first half on record
summary: Settled catastrophe bond issuance topped roughly $16 billion by mid-2026, putting the insurance-linked securities market on pace for one of its strongest half-years ever as investor appetite for cat risk keeps growing.

summary: Australia's QBE Insurance Group completed the purchase of the remaining 51% stake in Raheja QBE General Insurance from building-materials firm Prism Johnson for about $34 million, giving QBE full ownership after IRDAI approval and setting up a rebrand of the unit.

summary: Lloyd's of London outlined its market oversight priorities for 2026, including new credit-risk codes for the year of account and an updated realistic disaster scenario data collection, as the marketplace executes a five-year strategy centered on underwriting discipline and returns.

headline: Carriers reposition AI as a loss-prevention tool, not just a pricing engine
summary: Insurance executives are increasingly framing artificial intelligence's biggest payoff as helping policyholders avoid losses before they happen, rather than only sharpening how underwriters price and select risk.

summary: New regulations taking effect July 31, 2026 let UK defined-contribution pension benefits be transferred into authorised collective defined contribution (CDC) schemes without individual member consent, alongside rules enabling new multi-employer CDC arrangements.

headline: Squeezed on fees, retirement recordkeepers lean harder on AI and pooled plans for growth
summary: A 2026 industry survey found pooled employer plan adoption jumped nearly 45% year over year, with recordkeepers turning to artificial intelligence to cut costs even as some expect it to shrink their own headcount within a few years.

headline: AI-focused advisor startups drive an 83% jump in US wealthtech funding

headline: Independent advisory firm Modera brings in new investment and operations chiefs
summary: Modera Wealth Management named a new chief investment officer and chief operating officer, both wealth management veterans, as the RIA looks to expand its investment offerings and modernize its technology platform.

headline: AI-powered MGA Mile Auto acquires The Insurance House
summary: Mile Auto, a pay-per-mile auto insurance MGA, acquired agency The Insurance House effective July 1, creating a combined operation with nearly $100 million in annual premium serving over 55,000 policyholders across roughly 1,600 agencies.

summary: Feathery, an AI operating and decisioning platform for financial services firms, raised a $30 million Series A led by Portage Ventures and Index Ventures, with backers including Allstate Strategic Ventures and Bain Capital Ventures.

summary: Embedded-insurance platform Kayna teamed up with broker Willis to target coverage gaps among subcontractors, aiming to make it easier to verify and bind insurance for gig and trade-based construction workers.

summary: CVS Health's Caremark PBM reached a global settlement with the FTC resolving rebate, pharmacy-network and vertical-integration allegations, agreeing to steer patients to lowest-cost drug options and stop restricting independent "hub" pharmacies.

summary: Alignment Healthcare and SCAN filed new suits against CMS seeking higher Medicare Advantage Star ratings, joining a wider wave of litigation that followed Clover Health's May court win over how CMS calculated quality measures.

summary: UCSF Health, Kleiner Perkins and Doerr Capital unveiled "UCSF Health Converge," an accelerator embedding startups with clinicians and operators inside the academic health system to build and validate AI tools in live care settings.

summary: CMS indicated in proposed 2027 hospital-outpatient and physician-fee rules that it intends to build a more consistent payment structure for clinical software and AI tools tied to their measured impact on patient outcomes.

summary: The Simon-Kucher Insurtech Tracker found AI-focused companies took in $820 million, or 97% of all disclosed insurtech funding, in the first half of 2026, as investor attention shifts from purchase-flow digitization to rebuilding insurers' operating infrastructure.

headline: Compliance-AI startup Norm AI raises $120 million, crosses unicorn threshold
summary: Norm AI closed a $120 million Series C led by Khosla Ventures at a $1.2 billion valuation, reaching unicorn status less than three years after founding.

summary: Goldman Sachs Asset Management now manages $651 billion in general-account assets for insurance clients, and its latest insurer survey found 62% plan to increase allocations to private assets in 2026.

headline: Advisor360° unveils AI-native wealth management operating system
summary: Wealthtech platform Advisor360° launched what it calls an AI-native operating system for wealth managers, aiming to embed AI-driven workflows across planning, portfolio and client-service functions rather than bolting AI onto legacy tools.

headline: Zywave launches Apex, an AI-native growth stack built for insurance distribution
summary: The insurance broker technology specialist introduced Zywave Apex, aimed at speeding up quoting, sharpening account intelligence and giving agencies clearer pipeline visibility across the front office.

summary: The partnership gives First Connect's network of independent agents discounted access to EZLynx's agency management platform, bundling automation and AI across policy management, accounting and marketing.

summary: Aon-owned broker NFP announced the acquisition of Total Benefits Advisors, a Cleveland, Ohio firm spanning retirement services, employee benefits and wealth management for business owners and high-net-worth clients.

summary: Global investment firm KKR joined the existing takeover consortium pursuing insurance broker network Steadfast Group, with the group's due diligence period extended by four weeks and the A$6-per-share offer unchanged.

headline: FinTech Junction 2026 returns to Tel Aviv, drawing insurance, payments and AI leaders
summary: Israel's leading annual fintech conference brought together senior leaders from banking, insurance, cybersecurity, payments and the startup ecosystem for a day of programming aimed at enterprise decision-makers.

summary: UnitedHealth reported second-quarter revenue of $112 billion and adjusted earnings of $6.38 per share, raising full-year adjusted guidance to $19.50-$20.00 per share as its medical cost ratio improved from the prior year.

summary: CMS is gathering feedback on how to define PBM affiliates and enforce flat, non-drug-price-linked bona fide service fee compensation limits taking effect in 2028 under the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, with comments due July 20.

summary: Sens. Richard Blumenthal and Josh Hawley sent letters demanding records on how each insurer's Medicare Advantage plans use algorithms in post-acute care coverage decisions, giving the companies until July 28 to respond.

summary: General insurers collected roughly Rs 1.24 lakh crore in health insurance premiums over eleven months of the current fiscal year, the industry's highest-ever total, following September 2025's GST exemption on individual health policies.

summary: Mayo Clinic clinicians are using a new AI tool that generates chronological patient summaries and makes searching medical records faster, part of a broader deployment of around 150 AI models across the hospital.

summary: Second-quarter cat bond issuance alone topped $11.3 billion, pushing first-half volume to an all-time high as investor capital continues flooding into insurance-linked securities.

summary: Record capital inflows and a quieter 2025 hurricane season drove some of the steepest reinsurance property rate declines in decades at the July 1 renewal date, easing costs for primary insurers.

summary: LIMRA's first-quarter 2026 data show individual life insurance sales continuing to build on 2025's record pace, with indexed universal life remaining the fastest-growing segment.

summary: A new market analysis frames insurance third-party administration as a $544.67 billion global industry increasingly dominated by AI-equipped incumbents Sedgwick, Crawford & Company and CorVel Corp.

headline: Sedgwick earns Great Place To Work certification for fifth consecutive year

summary: Healthcare Dive reports new CMS marketplace data show rising 2026 ACA premiums are driving more enrollees toward high-deductible bronze plans as enhanced subsidies shrink.

summary: Industry coverage shows private insurers grew retail annualized premium equivalent about 15% year-on-year while Sanlam raised its stake in Shriram Life to just over 52%, funding technology and distribution expansion.

summary: Browne Jacobson analysis finds record claims payouts, climate-driven catastrophe losses and a fragile pricing recovery are squeezing margins and capacity across the UK property insurance market in 2026.

headline: Pooled employer plan adoption jumps nearly 45% as recordkeepers chase PEP growth
summary: PLANADVISER's 2026 recordkeeping survey found employer adoption of pooled employer plans rose to almost 10,800 from roughly 7,450 a year earlier, with recordkeepers expecting PEPs to drive a large share of 2026 sales growth.

headline: Human Interest launches AI-driven compliance guarantee for 401(k) plans
summary: The digital retirement-plan provider unveiled an AI tool that proactively checks payroll cycles and recordkeeping data against compliance benchmarks, giving plan administrators real-time health indicators.

headline: Consolidation continues to reshape the third-party administrator sector
summary: Employee Benefit News reports private equity and larger benefits players are increasingly acquiring third-party administrators as the TPA market consolidates around scale and technology investment.

headline: Wealth Enhancement adds three RIAs totaling more than $1.1 billion in assets
summary: The Minneapolis-based aggregator continued its rapid acquisition pace, striking three separate RIA deals that together bring in over $1.1 billion of client assets.

headline: Broker consolidation cools to its slowest pace in a decade
summary: First-quarter 2026 insurance distribution deal volume fell to its lowest level since 2016, with just three acquirers (BroadStreet Partners, Inszone and ALKEME) responsible for nearly a third of all announced transactions. Higher borrowing costs and a more cautious lending environment are pushing buyers toward smaller, more disciplined tuck-in deals rather than large platform purchases.

headline: Gallagher expands into Canadian renters insurance with Apollo buyout
summary: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. agreed to acquire Vancouver-based Apollo Insurance Solutions, a digital MGA/broker focused on AI-driven tenant insurance placement across Canada. Deal terms were undisclosed, and Apollo's team will continue operating under Gallagher's Canada/Latin America retail P&C leadership.

headline: Broker deal multiples hold up even as AI casts a shadow over the sector
summary: A 2026 broker M&A outlook finds that while AI-driven disruption fears have added scrutiny to deals and pressured some public broker valuations, well-run agencies and niche MGAs are still commanding strong, in some cases mid-to-high-teens, EBITDA multiples. Analysts expect another active year for brokerage consolidation despite the uncertainty.

headline: Parametric risk startup InRisk Labs lands $27M to expand catastrophe modeling
summary: InRisk Labs, an Indian parametric insurtech, raised a $27 million Series A co-led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Northpoint Capital. The company plans to use the funds to build out underwriting, actuarial and catastrophe-modeling capabilities and expand into natural catastrophe, marine cargo and motor insurance.

headline: Balkan insurtech Ominimo crosses unicorn threshold on profitable growth
summary: Serbian-Hungarian insurtech Ominimo raised €20.1 million, pushing its valuation to €1.4 billion just two years after launch. The company is notable for reaching unicorn status while already profitable, a rarer path in a European insurtech funding market that has otherwise concentrated capital in a handful of large late-stage deals.

headline: Global insurtech investment outpaces all of 2025 within just two quarters
summary: Global insurtech funding reached roughly $1.54 billion across 27 disclosed deals through the first half of 2026, already surpassing full-year 2025 totals, with AI-focused startups and later-stage follow-on rounds capturing the bulk of capital. North America led both deal count and dollars raised, while Europe's total was buoyed by a small number of large financings.

headline: Wealthtech platform Altruist readies general rollout of its AI planning agent
summary: Altruist is opening broader access to Hazel, an AI agent that compresses a roughly 18-hour financial-planning process into minutes by analyzing client documents and generating tailored plans, ahead of a targeted August 2026 general launch. The custodian-agnostic tool underscores accelerating AI adoption across wealth and insurance-adjacent advisory platforms.

headline: Centene rebounds to over $1 billion profit and raises its outlook again
summary: Centene reported $53.6 billion in second-quarter 2026 revenue, up 10% year-over-year, and swung to more than $1 billion in profit, prompting the managed-care insurer to raise its full-year earnings guidance for the second time in 2026. Executives pointed to narrowing gaps between premium rates and member medical acuity, a trend also cited by UnitedHealth and Elevance this quarter.

headline: CMS reopens Medicare Advantage bidding after revising star-rating scores
summary: CMS is recalculating 2026 Medicare Advantage star ratings, restoring some bonus payments to plans and reopening the 2027 bid process as a result. The move comes as average MA-PD star ratings have declined and CMS's finalized CY2027 rules narrow the margin for plans to earn top quality scores.

headline: CVS Health taps a UnitedHealthcare veteran to run Aetna
summary: CVS Health named a former UnitedHealthcare executive as the new chief executive of its Aetna insurance unit, part of a broader leadership reset across the company's health-benefits business. The appointment continues a pattern of cross-payer executive movement among the largest national health insurers.

headline: Global insurtech funding jumps to a four-year high, almost entirely on AI bets
summary: Worldwide insurtech investment hit roughly $2.44 billion in the second quarter of 2026, the strongest quarter since 2022, with more than 99% of that capital flowing into AI-focused insurance startups. Large mega-rounds, rather than broad deal-count growth, drove most of the increase.

headline: Specialty insurer rolls out coverage built for AI data centers and crypto mining rigs
summary: A unit of Ryan Specialty launched a new managing general underwriter dedicated to insuring computing hardware used in artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, and cryptocurrency mining operations. The move responds to surging demand for specialty property coverage as data-center and AI infrastructure buildouts accelerate.

headline: EU regulators tighten scrutiny of private-equity-owned insurers
summary: Europe's insurance regulator EIOPA is finalizing supervisory guidance requiring private-equity buyers of insurers to disclose how long they intend to stay invested and how ownership and reinsurance structures might expose policyholders to added risk. The move follows growing regulatory unease over PE and asset-manager involvement in insurance balance sheets and funded reinsurance deals.

headline: Target-Date Fund Assets Swell to $4.8 Trillion as Collective Trusts Overtake Mutual Funds
summary: Morningstar's 2026 target-date landscape report shows industry assets grew more than 20% last year to $4.8 trillion, with the top five providers controlling about 80% of the market and collective investment trusts now the leading vehicle ahead of mutual funds.

headline: AXA Posts Modest Profit Gain as It Resets Strategy After Exiting Asset Management
summary: AXA reported first-half profit slightly ahead of last year and reaffirmed its full-year earnings and return-on-equity targets, as CEO Thomas Buberl refocuses the group on core insurance following its roughly 5.1 billion euro sale of its asset-management arm.

headline: India Lets Insurers Push Foreign Ownership Past 74% Under Sweeping IRDAI Overhaul
summary: Following the government's move to allow up to 100% foreign investment in insurers, at least one life insurer and one general insurer have already raised foreign shareholding beyond the prior 74% cap, part of a broader IRDAI reform package that also eases investment norms and restructuring rules.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life Elevates President Conor Murphy to Succeed Retiring CEO Chris Blunt
summary: F&G is promoting current President and CFO Conor Murphy to the chief executive role as longtime CEO Chris Blunt steps back to focus on board duties and a subsidiary post, with a new CFO arriving from Corebridge Financial to round out the leadership reshuffle.

headline: Asia-Pacific Life Insurers Positioned for Multi-Year Run Toward a $1.6 Trillion Market
summary: Analysts expect Asia-Pacific life insurance to grow roughly 7.3% annually, expanding from about $1.2 trillion today to $1.6 trillion by 2029, with India's Shriram Life and HDFC Life pointing to bancassurance expansion and favorable demographics as growth drivers.

headline: Private-Equity-Backed Reinsurers Are Absorbing a Growing Slice of Life and Annuity Risk
summary: S&P Global Market Intelligence finds affiliated, PE-owned reinsurers are taking on an increasing share of ceded life and annuity liabilities, as alternative asset managers keep pursuing stable long-duration liabilities to feed their investment platforms.

headline: Wildfire exposure pushes catastrophe bond sales toward record territory
summary: Insurers have issued more than $5 billion of catastrophe bonds carrying wildfire exposure so far in 2026, nearing last year's record total, as carriers lean harder on capital markets to offload rising wildfire risk. The surge reflects insurers' growing appetite to transfer climate-driven property losses to investors rather than retain them.

headline: Chubb's underwriting profit climbs nearly 19% as catastrophe losses ease
summary: Chubb reported second-quarter 2026 P&C underwriting income of $1.94 billion, up 18.8% year-over-year, with its combined ratio improving to 83.8% as pre-tax catastrophe losses fell to $475 million from $630 million a year earlier. The results stand out against a broader Q2 earnings season where several peers saw combined ratios worsen on rising cat losses.

headline: Sapiens taps its own CFO to lead next phase of AI-driven overhaul
summary: Core-systems vendor Sapiens named CFO Paul Wheeler as incoming CEO, with Executive Chairman Mike Ettling stepping back after serving as interim chief. Wheeler will formally take the helm around the company's October summit as Sapiens pushes further into becoming an AI-native insurance software provider.

headline: State regulators widen their multi-state trial of an AI oversight tool for insurers
summary: The NAIC's pilot of its AI Systems Evaluation Tool, which tests how regulators can assess insurers' AI governance and third-party model risk, has grown to 12 participating states after California joined. The program runs through September 2026 and is expected to inform a broader adoption decision at the NAIC's fall national meeting.

headline: UK Regulator Refreshes Superfund Rulebook Ahead of New Pension Schemes Act Regime
summary: The Pensions Regulator issued updated technical guidance for defined-benefit superfunds, including revised funding-level and wind-up-trigger definitions, to bridge the gap before the formal superfund regime created by the Pension Schemes Act 2026 comes into force.

headline: Australian claims administrator rebuilds its entire operation on an AI claims platform
summary: Quartz Claims, a TPA operating across Australia and New Zealand, has moved its full claims operation onto Five Sigma's AI-powered claims management platform, including its Clive AI system, as core infrastructure. The move is part of a wider regional trend of TPAs replacing legacy claims systems with AI-native platforms.

headline: Carlyle and Bain Face Off in $7 Billion Battle for Wealth Enhancement Group
summary: Carlyle Group and Bain Capital have emerged as the final bidders for Minneapolis-based RIA Wealth Enhancement Group, valuing the roughly $160 billion advisory firm at about $7 billion in what would rank among the largest wealth-management buyouts ever and the firm's fifth private-equity owner since 2007.

headline: Startup Astraeus Debuts AI Infrastructure Built Specifically for Regulated Advisory Firms
summary: New entrant Astraeus launched an AI-native platform designed to give advisory firms artificial intelligence tools tailored to their own compliance requirements and client context, joining a crowded field of wealthtech vendors racing to bring AI into the front office.

headline: 360 ONE Wealth Sets Sights on a Bigger Share of India's Ultra-Rich Clientele
summary: India's largest independent wealth manager, 360 ONE WAM, is aiming to grow its share of the ultra-high-net-worth segment from roughly 10% to 12-13%, its CEO said, as competition intensifies for India's fast-expanding pool of wealthy families.

headline: Insurance industry sees a fresh wave of senior appointments across wholesale and program business
summary: A round of executive moves this week spanned wholesale E&S, risk advisory, actuarial leadership and insurtech distribution roles at major brokers and carriers.

headline: Curant.ai raises $3.1 million seed round to scale AI-powered claims automation
summary: The Utah-based startup, led by Diagram with participation from Humania Insurance and Element Ventures, builds AI software that extracts data from documents to speed disability claims adjudication for insurers.

headline: UnitedHealth raises 2026 guidance again as cost controls drive a Q2 earnings beat
summary: UnitedHealth posted adjusted earnings of $6.38 per share, well above analyst estimates, and raised full-year guidance as its medical benefit ratio improved on benefit redesigns and updated pricing.

headline: Hospital M&A activity accelerates through 2026 as health systems resume dealmaking
summary: Health systems that paused deals in 2025 amid policy uncertainty have resumed mergers, with 40 hospital transactions announced in the first half of 2026, including Community Health Systems' planned sale of its three-hospital Commonwealth Health system.

headline: Corgi secures $108 million and regulatory approval to launch AI-native carrier for startups
summary: Y Combinator alum Corgi obtained carrier authority and funding to operate what it calls the first AI-native, full-stack insurer built specifically for startup companies, offering D&O, E&O and cyber coverage.

headline: NAIC's Life Insurance and Annuities Committee convenes at Summer National Meeting in Columbus
summary: State insurance regulators are set to meet August 12 in Columbus as part of the NAIC's 2026 Summer National Meeting to discuss policy priorities affecting life and annuity products.

headline: UK and EU regulators advance Solvency II reporting changes and insurer resolution rules
summary: The PRA published a policy statement amending UK Solvency reporting and own-funds requirements, while the European Commission adopted new technical standards under Solvency II and EIOPA issued final guidance on the Insurance Recovery and Resolution Directive.

headline: Orion180 lifts reinsurance coverage 36% to $1.15 billion ahead of hurricane season
summary: The Florida-based insurer expanded its 2026 reinsurance tower and broadened the number of catastrophic events covered as it prepares for the Atlantic hurricane season.

headline: Shinhan Asset Management's target-date fund series tops 2 trillion won in assets
summary: South Korean retirement savers have poured over 600 billion won into Shinhan's TDF lineup this year alone, pushing total assets past the 2 trillion won mark as investors favor its retirement-timed allocation strategy amid market volatility.

headline: US wealthtech funding halves year-over-year in Q2 2026 as mega-deals dry up
summary: Wealthtech companies raised $557.8 million across 91 deals in the second quarter, down 41% from the prior quarter, as the number of rounds above $100 million shrank sharply.

headline: RIA dealmaking shatters records, on pace for nearly 500 transactions in 2026
summary: Wealth management M&A hit its busiest first half on record with 262 deals, as repeat private-equity-backed acquirers and a wave of platform capital raises pushed sponsor-backed activity to an all-time high.

headline: Lower middle-market buyers reshape the insurance agency M&A landscape
summary: With AssuredPartners, Risk Strategies and Trucordia now absorbed into larger platforms, a new CT Acquisitions guide finds a fresh generation of private-equity-backed and independent buyers competing for lower middle-market insurance agencies as consolidation among the largest brokers slows.

headline: Health insurers struggle to close the personalization gap in wellness programs
summary: Health insurers are investing heavily in wellness programs to boost member engagement, but many still rely on broad demographic segmentation rather than behavioral data and adaptive models, limiting the personalization needed to improve prevention outcomes.

headline: Newgen Software names Tarun Nandwani CEO for 18-month term
summary: Newgen Software, whose BPM and automation platforms serve banks and insurers, appointed 33-year company veteran Tarun Nandwani as CEO for an 18-month term starting August 1, alongside a broader leadership reshuffle naming Pramod Kumar as Chief Growth Officer.

headline: UnitedHealth raises 2026 guidance again after strong Q2 cost control
summary: UnitedHealth Group posted a $5.48 billion second-quarter profit on roughly flat revenue of $112 billion and raised its 2026 adjusted earnings outlook to $19.50-$20 per share, up from a prior forecast of more than $18.25, as cost-control measures continued to pay off.

headline: ACA marketplace premiums set to jump 26% on average as enhanced subsidies lapse
summary: Newly unveiled 2026 ACA marketplace filings show premiums rising 26% on average -- 30% in states on the federal HealthCare.gov exchange -- as enhanced premium tax credits that expired at the end of 2025 push out-of-pocket costs sharply higher for enrollees.

headline: Molina to shrink ACA marketplace membership by half, exit traditional Medicare Advantage in 2027
summary: Molina Healthcare expects its ACA exchange membership to roughly halve to about 220,000 by year-end, down from 655,000 a year earlier, and confirmed plans to exit the traditional Medicare Advantage and Part D market in 2027 after missing its 2026 profit forecast by half.

headline: UnitedHealthcare and Humana retreat from Medicare Advantage counties for 2026
summary: The two largest Medicare Advantage insurers are pulling back for 2026, with UnitedHealthcare exiting 225 counties while entering just 14, and Humana exiting 198 counties while entering five, as CMS's 2026 final rule also tightens prior-authorization and appeals protections.

headline: Roche to acquire AI pathology firm PathAI for up to $1.05 billion
summary: Roche agreed to acquire Boston-based digital pathology company PathAI for up to $1.05 billion -- $750 million upfront plus $300 million in milestones -- expanding its AI-assisted pathology portfolio built on the companies' partnership since 2021.

headline: WellSky expands care-transition dashboards to 2,000 hospitals to curb discharge delays
summary: WellSky expanded its CarePort Care Transitions Dashboard Suite with new intelligence dashboards that give hospital and health-system teams real-time visibility into referral bottlenecks and discharge-performance benchmarks, drawing on a network spanning over 2,000 hospitals and 120,000 post-acute providers.

headline: Intermountain, Cooper University Healthcare cut documentation time sharply with ambient AI
summary: Intermountain Health cut time spent on clinical notes per appointment by 27% using Microsoft's Dragon Copilot, while Cooper University Healthcare saved clinicians more than an hour of documentation time daily, part of a broader wave of ambient AI adoption reducing charting burden for nurses and physicians.

headline: Global insurtech funding hits $2.44 billion in Q2 2026, the highest since 2022
summary: Gallagher Re's Global InsurTech Report found Q2 2026 funding reached $2.44 billion, the highest quarterly total since Q2 2022, with 99.1% of the capital flowing to AI-focused companies even as early-stage funding fell more than 50% quarter-over-quarter.

headline: AI governance becomes central theme as insurers move past experimentation
summary: Insurers are shifting from AI experimentation toward structured adoption, with governance, accountability and decision oversight emerging as central themes at industry events like MGAA 2026 as carriers embed AI into core operational workflows.

headline: SquareTrade Europe launches Brussels-based licensed insurer
summary: Allstate-owned device-protection provider SquareTrade launched a licensed insurance entity in Brussels, bringing underwriting in-house across its 15-market European footprint of more than nine million active customers and enabling faster product launches via EU passporting rights.

headline: Goldman Sachs: insurer portfolios to stay stable in 2026 with deeper private-credit tilt
summary: Goldman Sachs Asset Management's 2026 Global Insurance Survey finds insurer investment portfolios are expected to stay broadly stable in 2026, with solid credit quality and continued reliance on private credit and alternative assets even as AI adoption in investment decisions accelerates.

headline: Third-party reinsurance capital projected to grow 6% to $130 billion in 2026
summary: AM Best and Guy Carpenter project alternative and third-party reinsurance capital will grow 6% to $130 billion in 2026, as investors keep channeling capital into insurance-linked securities and collateralized reinsurance vehicles.

headline: Zurich secures $1 billion quota-share reinsurance deal for data-center risk
summary: Zurich arranged a $1 billion quota-share reinsurance placement to support its growing book of underwriting risk tied to data centers, part of a broader trend of insurers building capacity for technology-infrastructure exposures.

headline: LIMRA: U.S. annuity sales set new quarterly record at $123.9 billion in Q2 2026
summary: LIMRA's preliminary Q2 survey found total U.S. annuity sales rose 4% year-over-year to a record $123.9 billion, the 11th straight quarter above $100 billion, with registered index-linked and single-premium immediate annuities each hitting new quarterly highs.

headline: Swiss Re's life and health reinsurance profit climbs to $1.05 billion in first half of 2026
summary: Swiss Re reported first-half 2026 net income of $2.8 billion, up 9% year-over-year, with its life and health reinsurance segment posting $1.05 billion in profit versus $839 million a year earlier, aided by disciplined underwriting and a benign catastrophe environment.

headline: EU AI Act's high-risk obligations become binding for life and health underwriting
summary: The EU AI Act's high-risk system obligations became enforceable on August 2, classifying AI used for underwriting, pricing and risk-scoring in life and health insurance as high-risk and subject to conformity assessments and human oversight, though a late-July political deal pushed some sensitive-use deadlines to December 2027.

headline: American Family to acquire Bowhead Specialty in $1.2 billion cash deal
summary: American Family Mutual Insurance agreed to acquire the roughly 86% of Bowhead Specialty it doesn't already own for $34 per share in cash, valuing the casualty and professional-liability specialty insurer at about $1.2 billion, an 11% premium to its pre-announcement close.

headline: Pet insurance MGAs fuel rapid, profitable growth as US penetration still trails Europe
summary: AM Best data shows US pet insurance direct premiums rose 16.5% in Q1 2026 toward a projected $6.4 billion for the year, with managing general agents driving distribution even though penetration remains around 4.6%, far below the UK's 25%-plus and Sweden's nearly 40%.

headline: Zurich's P&C business posts record first half as capital strength climbs
summary: Zurich Insurance's property and casualty segment delivered its strongest first-half performance on record, with business operating profit rising 16% to $2.8 billion, while the group's Swiss Solvency Test ratio climbed to 266%, well above its 160% minimum target.

headline: Trump executive order pushes 401(k) access to private equity and crypto
summary: President Trump signed an executive order on August 7 directing the Department of Labor, SEC and Treasury to review and revise guidance to make it easier for participant-directed 401(k) plans to include alternative investments such as private equity and cryptocurrency.

headline: IRS to issue opinion letters for pre-approved DC plans by August 31
summary: The IRS expects to issue Cycle 4 opinion letters for pre-approved defined contribution plans around August 31, with a formal announcement in its Internal Revenue Bulletin setting the deadline for plan sponsors to adopt updated pre-approved plan documents.

headline: Collective investment trusts keep gaining ground in the target-date fund market
summary: Twenty years after the Pension Protection Act enabled automatic enrollment, collective investment trusts are increasingly displacing mutual funds in target-date lineups as plan sponsors seek lower, more customizable fee structures, with total target-date series reaching a record 164 by year-end 2025.

headline: Insurance TPA market valued at $592.5 billion in 2026, projected to top $845 billion by 2031
summary: The global insurance third-party administrator market is valued at $592.52 billion in 2026 and forecast to reach $845.30 billion by 2031, a 7.36% CAGR driven by self-funded health plan growth and AI-driven claims automation.

headline: New law expands compensation-disclosure duties to TPAs and stop-loss carriers
summary: The Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026 extends compensation-disclosure requirements beyond brokers to third-party administrators, PBMs, stop-loss carriers and other group-health-plan vendors, requiring disclosure of direct and indirect compensation before contracts take effect, with penalties up to $10,000 per day for noncompliance.

headline: AlphaCore expands into New Jersey with $700 million Brave Family Advisors deal
summary: AlphaCore Wealth Advisory acquired Brave Family Advisors, a $700 million New Jersey RIA founded in 1992, adding eight staff including four advisers and opening AlphaCore's first Summit, NJ office as part of a Northeast expansion push.

headline: Carlyle takes minority stake in Prime Capital Financial at $1.8 billion-plus valuation
summary: Carlyle agreed to provide a $600 million hybrid capital solution and take a minority stake in Prime Capital Financial, valuing the nearly $50 billion-AUM RIA at over $1.8 billion, as prior investor Abry Partners exits its position.

headline: &Partners recruits $1.8 billion Mississippi team from Wells Fargo
summary: Hybrid RIA &Partners added a four-advisor Meridian, Mississippi team managing $1.8 billion that departed Wells Fargo Advisors to launch as 32 North Wealth, capping a month that brought &Partners to 121 advisor practices and roughly $58 billion in assets.

headline: Insurity names Jatin Atre CEO with $100 million AI commitment
summary: P&C-focused insurance software provider Insurity appointed Jatin Atre as CEO, succeeding Jeff Clarke who becomes executive chairman, alongside a new $100 million commitment over two years to modernize core systems with embedded AI.

headline: IRDAI weighs overhaul of insurance distributor commissions
summary: India's insurance regulator is considering replacing large upfront distributor commissions, currently as high as 40% on some life and health products, with payments staggered over a policy's life to curb mis-selling and align with global norms.

headline: Weekly fintech funding falls to $673 million as deal pace slows
summary: Fintech startups raised a combined $673 million across 15 deals in the first week of August 2026, a sharp pullback from the $2.03 billion raised the prior week, reflecting more selective investor appetite.

headline: Health systems report major time savings from AI documentation tools
summary: Intermountain Health cut time spent on visit notes by 27% using Microsoft's Dragon Copilot, while Cooper University Healthcare and Mercy reported clinicians saving over an hour of documentation time per shift using similar ambient AI scribe tools.

headline: Insurtech funding hits four-year high as AI captures 99% of capital
summary: Gallagher Re reported global insurtech funding reached $2.44 billion in Q2 2026, the highest quarterly total in four years, with AI-focused companies capturing 99.1% of all investment and mega-rounds over $100 million driving much of the increase.

headline: VisionTrack names Richard Lilwall CEO of AI telematics platform
summary: AI video telematics and connected fleet data specialist VisionTrack, part of Markerstudy Group, appointed Richard Lilwall as chief executive, succeeding Ben Pickard who returns to the CFO role.

headline: PIMCO keeps pulling in outside money as Allianz boosts its stake
summary: PIMCO drew €31.7 billion in third-party net inflows in Q2 2026 with further gains in July, even as parent Allianz increased its ownership stake in the fixed-income manager.

headline: Great Eastern's Singapore business outpaces Malaysia recovery in first half
summary: Great Eastern reported first-half 2026 weighted new sales up 15% year over year to S$813.2 million, led by strong Singapore agency growth, while its Malaysia unit posted more modest gains amid softer product demand.

headline: Munich Re names AI, cyber and climate as top themes for reinsurers
summary: Munich Re and ERGO's 2026 Tech Trend Radar identified AI, cyber resilience, climate analytics and emerging liability as the defining strategic themes for reinsurers this year, with 63% of surveyed executives wanting cover against AI-related risks.

headline: Health Affairs proposes overhaul of employer TPA accountability rules
summary: A Health Affairs analysis argues Congress should give self-funded employers a more accountable and transparent option for administering medical benefit plans, citing the market power TPAs hold over the 165.6 million Americans in employer-sponsored coverage.

headline: Marpai's TPA and PBM platforms add 35,000 member lives in August
summary: Marpai said two major TPA clients representing roughly 35,000 member lives went live August 1, part of a projected 192,000-life expansion the company expects will push it to positive cash flow and EBITDA this quarter.

headline: Rockefeller adds $2.1 billion Merrill team in Columbus expansion
summary: Rockefeller Capital Management's Global Family Office recruited a multigenerational, multibillion-dollar advisory team led by Sidney Jones from Merrill, extending Rockefeller's wealth management footprint into a new Columbus, Ohio office.

headline: $400 million insurance and benefits brokerage prepares to spin off as standalone company
summary: A roughly $400 million insurance and employee-benefits brokerage business is being spun off from its parent to operate as an independent company.

headline: Oscar Health posts record first-half results, raises full-year guidance
summary: Oscar Health reported $362 million in net income and a 75% medical loss ratio for the first half of 2026, prompting the ACA-focused insurer to raise its full-year earnings guidance.

headline: The Institutes names Gen Re CEO Kara Raiguel to chair its board
summary: Industry education group The Institutes appointed Gen Re President and CEO Kara Raiguel to chair its Board of Trustees, with Selective's John Marchioni and Tokio Marine HCC's Susan Rivera joining as vice chairs.

headline: Health systems report major documentation-time savings from AI scribes
summary: Intermountain Health, Cooper University Healthcare and Mercy hospitals report significant reductions in clinical documentation time after deploying AI scribe tools such as Microsoft's Dragon Copilot.

headline: AI-focused startups captured 99% of Q2 2026 insurtech funding
summary: Nearly every dollar of Q2 2026 insurtech funding, 99.1%, went to AI-focused companies, with every round above $5 million landing at an AI-backed firm.

headline: Guidewire appoints AI transformation specialist to its board
summary: Insurance software vendor Guidewire named veteran insurance executive and AI transformation specialist Dr. Alexander Vollert to its board, with his term beginning August 1.

headline: Artisan Partners reports $183 billion in preliminary assets under management
summary: Asset manager Artisan Partners disclosed preliminary AUM of roughly $183 billion as of July 31, 2026, in a regulatory filing.

headline: IRDAI board approves sweeping reforms including liberalized insurer investment norms
summary: India's insurance regulator approved a broad reform package at its 137th Authority meeting, including looser investment rules, easier capital infusion, and a new policyholder protection fund regulation.

headline: Midyear outlook finds commercial P&C conditions turning more favorable for buyers
summary: Alera Group's midyear 2026 property and casualty update finds hard-market conditions easing, with more competition and capacity creating room for premium savings in several commercial lines.

headline: Catastrophe reinsurance prices post steepest annual fall in 25 years
summary: Guy Carpenter's Global Property Catastrophe Rate-on-Line Index fell 16% year-over-year at the June and July renewals, the steepest annual decline in a quarter-century, as record reinsurer capital pressures pricing.

headline: IRDAI grants ProTec General Insurance a license, its fourth approval of 2026
summary: India's insurance regulator granted a certificate of registration to ProTec General Insurance, the fourth new insurer license IRDAI has issued so far in 2026.

headline: Human Interest launches AI tool for automated 401(k) compliance monitoring
summary: Retirement plan provider Human Interest introduced a new AI-driven tool designed to automatically flag compliance issues for employers administering 401(k) plans.

headline: Recordkeepers report strong growth even as fee pressure intensifies
summary: Retirement plan recordkeepers say demand for pooled employer plans and wealth-management add-ons is fueling growth, even as declining fees push them to deliver more services and technology for less revenue per participant.

headline: Investcorp makes first wealth-management bet, taking majority stake in $3 billion RIA
summary: Alternative asset manager Investcorp acquired a majority stake in Berger Financial Group, a Minnesota-based RIA managing roughly $3 billion, marking Investcorp's debut investment in the wealth-management sector.

headline: Cambridge Investment Research deploys agentic AI to speed account opening
summary: Cambridge Investment Research rolled out an agentic AI tool that automates parts of its direct account-opening process, cutting a task that used to take 17 minutes down to seconds.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures sets Chicago convening for late August with growing sponsor lineup
summary: BrokerTech Ventures announced BrokerTech Connect: Chicago, running August 31-September 2, bringing together brokers, carriers, investors and insurtech founders for sessions on AI and the next generation of digital-first insurance organizations.

headline: AI-native brokerage platform AGI launches with $70 million to buy up agencies
summary: American Growth Insurance launched an AI-enabled brokerage growth platform backed by nearly $70 million in committed equity from Rockbridge Growth Equity and Atomic, and closed its first agency acquisition in Baltimore.

headline: Travel-insurance fintech Faye raises $50m Series C to build an AI travel wallet
summary: Faye raised a $50 million Series C led by Madrona at an estimated $500 million valuation, and plans to expand its Faye Wallet product so travelers can manage money and get AI-assisted claims support abroad.

headline: UnitedHealth's Q2 profit hits $5.4bn as it pours $1.5bn into AI cost controls
summary: UnitedHealth Group reported Q2 profit of $5.4 billion and raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance, as the insurer works to stabilize margins by shrinking membership, exiting unprofitable contracts and investing $1.5 billion in AI to streamline operations.

headline: Intermountain Health cuts documentation time 27% with Microsoft's Dragon Copilot
summary: Intermountain Health clinicians using Dragon Copilot for 10 or more encounters saw a 27% reduction in time spent on notes per appointment, based on Epic data, as the system scaled the ambient-AI tool across its enterprise.

headline: UC Irvine Health warns hospitals often don't know where every AI tool lives in their systems
summary: UC Irvine Health's chief medical informatics and AI officer, Dr. Deepti Pandita, said provider organizations may not always know where every AI tool exists in their operations, underscoring the need for system-wide AI awareness and governance.

headline: EU opens EUR9m fund for large-scale clinical AI imaging pilots
summary: The European Commission's Digital Europe Programme opened a call for proposals worth EUR9 million to fund large-scale pilots of cloud-based AI systems for medical imaging, focused on early detection of cancer and cardiovascular disease in hospitals.

headline: Insurity and ITS partner to close the insurance industry's technology execution gap
summary: Insurity and Insurance Technology Services announced a partnership aimed at reducing delivery risk on insurance technology rollouts, targeting the gap between purchasing new insurance software and actually getting it into production.

headline: Fidelity to add a guaranteed-income option to its target-date fund lineup
summary: Fidelity plans to launch Freedom Lifetime, a suite of target-date collective investment trusts with a built-in guaranteed-income feature backed by insurers including Nationwide and New York Life, available to plan sponsors in early 2027.

headline: Allianz to buy HSBC Life Singapore for roughly $2bn, locks in 15-year bancassurance tie-up
summary: Allianz agreed to acquire HSBC Life Singapore for about S$2.7 billion and signed a 15-year exclusive distribution partnership with HSBC Singapore, deepening its foothold in one of Asia's wealthiest insurance markets.

headline: LIC's quarterly profit jumps 23% as new-business margins widen sharply
summary: State-run insurer LIC reported a 23% year-on-year rise in first-quarter net profit to roughly Rs 13,492 crore, with value of new business surging 61% and margins expanding nearly 750 basis points.

headline: Mapfre to acquire Safety Insurance in $1.54bn deal, expanding New England reach
summary: Spanish insurer Mapfre agreed to buy Massachusetts-based Safety Insurance Group in an all-cash $1.54 billion deal at a 44% premium, creating the region's largest homeowners and commercial auto insurer.

headline: Allstate seeks Illinois homeowners rate hikes up to 10.4% as losses mount
summary: Allstate filed for new homeowners rate increases of up to 10.4% affecting more than 200,000 Illinois policyholders, citing severe weather and rising repair costs, reigniting debate over state rate-oversight rules.

headline: Zurich secures $1bn reinsurance backstop for its data-center portfolio
summary: Zurich Insurance entered a new quota-share reinsurance arrangement providing up to $1 billion of capacity to support its fast-growing data-center construction and property book, as AI-driven demand for data-center coverage surges.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance smashes records as wildfire-exposed deals surge
summary: Cat bond issuance topped $11 billion in the second quarter, the largest quarter on record, with wildfire-exposed issuance for the year climbing past $5 billion as investor appetite for insurance-linked securities keeps growing.

headline: Standard Life to buy Aegon UK for GBP2bn, creating the UK's largest retirement savings business
summary: Standard Life agreed to acquire Aegon's UK pensions and savings arm in a GBP2 billion deal, forming a combined retirement business serving 16 million customers with roughly GBP480 billion in assets under administration.

headline: Retirement Clearinghouse pitches centralized system to fix 401(k) rollover fragmentation
summary: Retirement Clearinghouse proposed a centralized clearinghouse to address fragmentation in the defined-contribution system, aiming to make it easier for savers to consolidate small accounts when they change jobs or roll into an IRA.

headline: Neal and Wyden introduce bill cracking down on outsized 'mega' retirement accounts
summary: House Ways and Means Ranking Member Richard Neal and Senator Ron Wyden introduced legislation aimed at curbing unusually large IRA and retirement-account balances, part of a broader push on retirement-savings fairness.

headline: New federal law widens fee-disclosure duties to TPAs and stop-loss insurers
summary: The Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2026 expanded compensation-disclosure obligations beyond pharmacy benefit managers to cover third-party administrators, stop-loss insurers and most other group health plan service providers, with penalties up to $10,000 a day for noncompliance.

headline: Global insurance TPA market keeps expanding as AI-driven claims automation spreads
summary: The insurance third-party-administrators market is on track to grow from roughly $372 billion to over $560 billion by 2030, with adoption of AI-driven claims automation and demand for scalable TPA platforms cited as key growth drivers.

headline: SUPERAGENT launches 3.0, billed as an AI 'business partner' for insurance agencies
summary: SUPERAGENT released version 3.0 on August 11, replacing traditional agency-software navigation with a conversational AI layer that executes calls, campaigns, renewals and training tasks using live agency data.

headline: Zurich clears final EU antitrust hurdle for GBP8.1 billion Beazley takeover
summary: The European Commission approved Zurich Insurance Group's acquisition of Lloyd's insurer Beazley under simplified merger review; the all-cash deal still needs sign-off from UK, Swiss and Lloyd's regulators.

headline: Reinsurance sidecars and ILS capital step in as traditional reinsurers pull back from MGAs
summary: Broker Gallagher Re says growing use of third-party capital, reinsurance sidecars and insurance-linked-securities investors is helping managing general agents replace underwriting capacity that major reinsurers have scaled back.

headline: Fisent Technologies raises $4.3 million to scale AI automation for regulated finance firms
summary: Fisent Technologies closed a $4.3 million venture round led by FINTOP, with FINTOP partner John Philpott joining its board, to expand its agentic AI platform for banking, insurance and wealth management workflows.

headline: Cover Genius buys German insurtech Friendsurance to expand DACH bancassurance push
summary: Embedded-protection platform Cover Genius acquired Berlin-based Friendsurance, combining its embedded insurance technology with Friendsurance's digital bancassurance and regulatory expertise across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

headline: SoftBank's PayPay to acquire 70% of T&D Financial Life in AI-driven insurance push
summary: PayPay agreed to acquire a 70.2% stake in T&D Financial Life for about JPY134.3 billion ($838 million) as part of a broader alliance with T&D Holdings to distribute insurance through its super-app and develop AI-powered products for Japan's aging population.

headline: India weighs national claims exchange and benchmarked treatment rates to curb medical inflation
summary: India is considering wide-ranging health insurance reforms, including standardized treatment-rate benchmarks and a nationwide claims exchange, as it seeks to improve transparency amid some of Asia's highest medical inflation.

headline: French digital insurer Alan raises EUR480 million at EUR5.5 billion valuation
summary: Alan closed a EUR480 million ($550 million) Series G round led by Prosus, with Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan participating for a third straight round, as the profitable French insurer targets Canada as a growth market.

headline: AI shifts from insurtech pitch to embedded infrastructure, VCs say
summary: Roughly 71% of applicants to the 2026 Global InsurTech Competition referenced AI or automation, but investors say the technology is increasingly treated as infrastructure embedded in underwriting and claims workflows rather than a standalone selling point.

headline: Artisan Partners reports $183 billion in assets under management
summary: Artisan Partners Asset Management disclosed preliminary assets under management of $183.0 billion as of July 31, 2026, giving an early read on mid-year flows for the publicly traded asset manager.

headline: AIA and Manulife post double-digit new-business growth across Asia
summary: AIA's China and Hong Kong operations drove group value of new business up double digits, while Manulife's Asia segment grew core earnings 21% and new business value 13%, both citing strength in Hong Kong, Singapore and mainland China.

headline: Auto insurance rates resume climbing across more than half of US states
summary: After easing in 2025, car insurance premiums are rising again in over half the country, with Connecticut drivers facing the steepest year-over-year increase at 15%, driven by higher repair costs and inflation, per Insurify data.

headline: Nevada moves to let home insurers exclude wildfire losses from standard policies
summary: Nevada will permit homeowners insurers to carve wildfire coverage out of standard policies starting in 2026, part of a broader wave of state-level moves on wildfire exposure management following record catastrophe losses.

headline: Voya extends 401(k) recordkeeping deal with law firm Baker Botts
summary: Voya Financial renewed its role as recordkeeper for international law firm Baker Botts effective August 1, continuing to serve more than 1,800 plan participants and roughly $900 million in retirement assets.

headline: Carlyle takes minority stake in Prime Capital Financial at $1.8 billion valuation
summary: Carlyle's Global Credit platform agreed to roughly a $600 million hybrid capital investment in Prime Capital Financial, valuing the RIA at more than $1.8 billion and letting prior backer Abry Partners exit after three years.

headline: Wealth Enhancement adds $592 million Illinois RIA Miramar Capital
summary: Wealth Enhancement acquired the investment advisory business of Miramar Capital, a Northbrook, Illinois-based independent RIA led by Bob Kalman and Max Wasserman that manages more than $592 million in client assets.

headline: Family-office wealthtech Asset Vantage names Nicole Eberhardt global CEO
summary: Asset Vantage, an AI-led SaaS platform serving more than 400 families across 10 countries, appointed Nicole Eberhardt as global chief executive effective August 1 to lead its next phase of product and international growth.

headline: bolt launches AI-powered insurance distribution platform
summary: Distribution technology provider bolt launched a new AI-driven platform combining three core distribution capabilities into a single insurance-focused system for carriers and agencies.

headline: Specialty carrier Everspan adds three senior leaders across reinsurance and underwriting
summary: Everspan Group named David Kenyon (ex-Zurich) head of reinsurance, Bevan Greibesland (ex-HDI Global) chief underwriting officer, and Forest Clay Stewart (ex-Chubb) chief operating officer, splitting out roles that had previously been combined.

headline: French insurers shift AI from pilot projects to front-line operations
summary: Insurers in France are moving past the decision of whether to use AI and are now focused on how to deploy it across underwriting and claims while keeping human decision-makers in control.

headline: Insurers sit on an underused distribution-data goldmine, industry analysis finds
summary: Carriers, MGAs and agencies have modernized their distribution technology in recent years but are still leaving significant value on the table from the data those systems generate, according to industry analysis.

headline: Asia's private health insurers warned of looming medical-cost "crisis"
summary: The Global Alliance for Insurance Pools warned that Asia's private health insurance sector could face a full-on sustainability crisis within two to three years without action on medical cost inflation, which is running near 14% regionally and higher in markets like Singapore.

headline: CVS Caremark survey finds employers leaning harder on PBMs to fight drug costs
summary: A CVS Caremark and Employee Benefit News survey found 88% of employers see PBMs as well-positioned to curb prescription drug costs, with GLP-1 access and biosimilar adoption among employers' top concerns.

headline: AI underwriting startup Sixfold teams up with Sollers Consulting
summary: Sixfold partnered with Sollers Consulting to help insurance carriers accelerate underwriting transformation, pairing Sixfold's AI-driven risk assessment with Sollers' implementation and consulting support.

headline: InsuranceDekho elevates chief revenue officer Abhishek Bansal to CEO
summary: Indian insurance marketplace InsuranceDekho promoted Chief Revenue Officer Abhishek Bansal to chief executive of its insurance business as part of a broader senior-leadership restructuring.

headline: Global catastrophe reinsurance pricing posts its steepest annual drop in 25 years
summary: Guy Carpenter's property-catastrophe rate-on-line index fell 16% year-over-year at the June/July renewals as record capital levels pressured pricing, even as a summer of frequent catastrophe events complicates the outlook for later renewals.

headline: Specialty reinsurer Pelagos misses Q2 estimates on Middle East and Qatar catastrophe losses
summary: Pelagos reported second-quarter operating earnings well below analyst consensus after $162 million in catastrophe and large losses, including charges tied to the Middle East conflict and a Qatar gas-plant explosion, weighed on underwriting results.

headline: India's government raises $3.3 billion selling down its stake in state insurer LIC
summary: New Delhi upsized an offer-for-sale of Life Insurance Corporation of India shares to 6.5% after strong demand, raising roughly $3.3 billion at a discounted price to trim the government's holding toward 90% and meet public-float rules.

headline: NAIC's property and casualty panel wraps summer session in Columbus
summary: The NAIC's Property and Casualty Insurance (C) Committee held its summer national meeting session on August 14 in Columbus, continuing regulatory work on catastrophe risk mitigation and market-conduct oversight.

headline: Travelers profit jumps 46% in Q2 as catastrophe losses ease
summary: Travelers reported second-quarter net income of $2.21 billion, up 46% year-over-year, as pre-tax catastrophe losses dropped to $518 million from $927 million a year earlier.

headline: United Fire Group posts its best catastrophe loss ratio in a decade
summary: United Fire Group reported a second-quarter catastrophe loss ratio of 2.7%, a 2.8-point improvement from a year earlier and well below its ten-year average, reflecting a comparatively quiet severe-weather season for the specialty carrier.

headline: IRS confirms higher 2026 contribution ceilings for 401(k) and IRA savers
summary: The IRS raised the 2026 401(k) elective-deferral limit to $24,500 and the IRA contribution limit to $7,500, giving workers more room to shelter retirement savings as inflation adjustments continue.

headline: Private equity firms step up their courtship of 401(k) plan sponsors
summary: With roughly $30 trillion sitting in US retirement accounts, private-equity firms are increasingly pitching plan sponsors and recordkeepers on giving savers access to alternative-asset strategies inside 401(k) menus.

headline: AI is reshaping wealth advisors' role rather than replacing them, analysts say
summary: LSEG Data & Analytics finds AI is shifting financial advisors away from manual information-gathering toward insight orchestration and client judgment, rather than displacing the advisor relationship.

headline: FE fundinfo accelerates rollout of its Nexus adviser platform
summary: FE fundinfo is stepping up investment in Nexus for Financial Advisers, its AI-powered workflow platform, with plans to add more than 25 new capabilities before the end of 2026.

headline: everyoneINVESTED and Prometeia pair up on behavioral-finance wealthtech
summary: The two wealthtech vendors partnered to embed everyoneINVESTED's behavioral-finance profiling tools into Prometeia's investment-advisory and portfolio-management platform.

headline: Mumbai forum spotlights AI and next-generation wealth transfer for Indian HNW clients
summary: The India Wealth Management Forum 2026 in Mumbai brought together advisors and family offices for sessions on generational wealth transfer, structuring, taking wealth global, and applying AI across advisory workflows.

headline: AGI raises $70 million to scale its AI-native insurance brokerage model
summary: AI-enabled brokerage platform AGI secured $70 million in private equity backing to accelerate growth, part of a broader push by investors to fund AI-native distribution models in insurance brokerage.

headline: Aon reshuffles Asia-Pacific broking leadership as regional expansion continues
summary: Aon named Helen Lockwood as Australian COO starting in January and expanded Ben Rolfe's remit to chief broking officer for the Pacific, part of a broader wave of senior broker moves across the region this month.

headline: U.S. MGA market swells to roughly $128 billion as specialization reshapes distribution
summary: The U.S. managing general agent market grew to about $128 billion in total premium flow in 2025, with MGA-written direct premium up 12% from 2024 as carriers and private equity firms extend their reach into specialty distribution.

headline: Fisent Technologies raises $4.3 million as it lands its first Fortune 50 customer
summary: Insurance fintech Fisent Technologies secured $4.3 million in new funding, citing growth across its enterprise business including its first Fortune 50 customer win in 2026.

headline: Weekly fintech funding climbs to $808 million as summer deal flow holds up
summary: Fintech venture funding rose to roughly $808 million across a dozen deals in the second week of August, up from about $673 million the prior week, as investor appetite for vertical fintech continues into late summer.

headline: Prior authorization denial rates vary wildly across major health insurers, new data shows
summary: First-of-its-kind data shows prior authorization denial rates ranging from 2% to 25% among major insurers, with at least one in eight standard requests denied across Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care and ACA marketplace plans.

headline: UnitedHealthcare, Humana and Aetna scale back Medicare Advantage offerings for 2026
summary: Major payers UnitedHealthcare, Humana and Aetna are trimming their Medicare Advantage plan footprints for 2026, part of an industry-wide pullback as insurers manage rising medical costs and tighter margins in the program.

headline: Horace Mann to acquire two Medical Mutual of Ohio benefits businesses for $240 million
summary: Horace Mann Educators agreed to acquire an employee assistance provider and a supplemental insurer from Medical Mutual of Ohio for about $240 million, adding roughly $200 million in annual revenue and over one million covered lives.

headline: Intermountain Health cuts clinician charting time 27% with Microsoft's Dragon Copilot
summary: Intermountain Health's system-wide rollout of Microsoft's Dragon Copilot ambient AI scribe has reduced time spent on clinical notes per appointment by 27% among clinicians with heavy usage, based on the health system's internal Epic data.

headline: Majority of home and community-based care providers now testing AI tools, survey finds
summary: An HHAeXchange survey found more than 57% of home- and community-based service providers are actively using, testing or evaluating AI tools, part of a broader wave of clinical and administrative AI adoption across care settings.

headline: Insurance data startup Axle raises $17.5 million Series A
summary: Axle, a startup building data infrastructure for the insurance industry, raised $17.5 million in a Series A round led by Base10 Partners, part of continued investor interest in vertical software for complex industries.

headline: Global insurtech funding hits $2.44 billion in strongest quarter since 2022
summary: Insurtech venture funding surged to $2.44 billion across 95 deals in the second quarter of 2026, the highest quarterly total in four years, though investors are increasingly favoring mature, AI-ready companies over early-stage startups.

headline: Majority of insurers plan to raise private credit exposure over the next two years
summary: A Marsh survey found more than half of insurers intend to increase private credit allocations, with investment-grade and asset-backed strategies drawing the strongest demand, up sharply from just 32% who said the same in 2024.

headline: Target-date funds approach $5 trillion as five firms control 80% of the market
summary: Target-date fund assets have grown to roughly $4.8 trillion, up over 20% year over year, with Vanguard alone holding about 37% of industry assets as adoption in workplace retirement plans becomes near-universal.

headline: LIMRA expects U.S. annuity sales to extend record streak through 2026
summary: LIMRA projects annuity sales will keep topping $100 billion per quarter as roughly four million Americans turn 65 each year and increasingly lack pension access, driving demand for guaranteed lifetime income products.

headline: Etiqa Insurance Singapore names Claudia Soh as permanent CEO
summary: Etiqa Insurance Singapore confirmed Claudia Soh as chief executive effective mid-August, after she spent six months serving as acting CEO while continuing as the insurer's chief financial officer.

headline: U.S. P&C insurers post $16.3 billion underwriting gain as combined ratio hits record Q1 low
summary: The U.S. property and casualty industry recorded a $16.3 billion net underwriting gain in the first quarter of 2026, reversing a $1 billion loss a year earlier, with a combined ratio of 89.5 marking the best first-quarter result on record.

headline: Asia commercial insurance rates keep falling, with Vietnam property the outlier
summary: Marsh's latest index shows Asia commercial insurance rates fell about 5% in the second quarter, matching the prior quarter's pace, while Vietnam property rates rose 13% on regulatory pricing tariffs even as Taiwan and Korea saw steep declines.

headline: Old Republic spins its third-party administrator business out as standalone brand Lodestar
summary: Old Republic International launched Lodestar Claims & Risk Services as an independent brand and standalone operating company, the first time in more than 30 years its TPA business has carried its own distinct market identity.

headline: TWFG's Q1 filing details $22.5 million acquisition of Texas MGA Asset Protection Insurance Associates
summary: TWFG's SEC filing shows the insurance distributor acquired APIA, a Texas-based MGA focused on property owners and real estate investors, for $22.5 million cash plus up to $7 million in earnout payments.

headline: Private equity-backed buyers drove roughly 76% of insurance agency acquisitions in first-half 2026
summary: BroadStreet Partners and Inszone Insurance Services led first-half 2026 insurance distribution M&A with 37 and 33 deals respectively, as PE-backed and hybrid buyers accounted for about three-quarters of all agency acquisitions even as overall deal pace slowed.

headline: CNBC names One Inc among top 500 global fintech companies for third straight year
summary: One Inc, a digital payments network built for the insurance industry's premium and claims disbursement workflows, was recognized in the Payments category of CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026 list, developed with Statista.

headline: CMS Medicare Advantage star-rating recalculation to drive over $13 billion in 2027 quality bonus spending
summary: A KFF analysis updated August 12, 2026 found CMS's recalculation of Medicare Advantage star ratings will push 2027 quality bonus program spending above $13 billion, with the bonus program continuing to boost payments to highly rated plans.

headline: PCMA launches public campaign defending PBMs against further regulation
summary: The Pharmaceutical Care Management Association launched a "What's Your PBM IQ?" public campaign on August 10, 2026, arguing pharmacy benefit managers already deliver savings as Congress weighs additional PBM reform following the Consolidated Appropriations Act's new rules.

headline: Hospitals report AI documentation tools are cutting nursing and physician charting time significantly
summary: Multiple health systems are reporting measurable time savings from ambient AI scribes and documentation tools, including a Mercy nurse in Missouri saving roughly two hours of charting per 12-hour shift, as governance concerns shift toward EHR integration.

headline: CMS finalizes FY2027 hospital inpatient payment rule
summary: CMS's FY2027 Inpatient Prospective Payment System and Long-Term Care Hospital final rule, published in the Federal Register on August 4, 2026, updates Medicare hospital payment rates, revises graduate medical education policy and expands quality reporting requirements ahead of an October 2026 effective date.

headline: Motilal Oswal AMC crosses ₹2 lakh crore in total assets under management
summary: Motilal Oswal Asset Management Company surpassed ₹2 lakh crore in combined mutual fund, AIF and PMS assets as of August 7, 2026, after adding more than 56 lakh new SIP accounts during the fiscal year.

headline: Insurer general account assets approach $8.7 trillion as carriers keep migrating into private credit
summary: Combined life and P&C insurer invested assets reached roughly $8.68 trillion at year-end 2025, with the 2026 Insurance Investment Outsourcing Report tracking a continued multiyear migration into private credit and alternatives amid new regulatory reporting rules.

headline: Shinhan Asset Management's target-date funds near $15 billion as Korean investors favor long-horizon strategies
summary: Shinhan Asset Management's two qualified target-date fund series held a combined 2.02 trillion won (about $14.6 billion) as of mid-August, with the firm's investment head urging long-term TDF investing over market timing.

headline: Jackson Financial posts record Q2 profit as annuity sales jump 34%
summary: Jackson Financial reported record second-quarter 2026 net income of $644 million and retail annuity sales of $5.9 billion, up 34% year-over-year, driven by record registered index-linked annuity volume.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life posts GAAP loss on mark-to-market swings despite strong retail annuity demand
summary: F&G reported an $81 million net loss for the second quarter of 2026 driven by mark-to-market effects, even as core retail annuity sales of $1.8 billion outperformed a contracting fixed indexed annuity market.

headline: Roper Technologies to shift 401(k) recordkeeping from Vanguard to Fidelity, triggering blackout period
summary: Roper Technologies disclosed a participant blackout period beginning in late September as its two 401(k) plans transition recordkeeping services from Vanguard to Fidelity Investments, effective October 2026.

headline: Edelman Financial Engines names first retirement advisory chief as wealth managers deepen leadership benches
summary: Edelman Financial Engines hired Christian Mango to lead a new retirement advisory practice, part of a wave of senior wealth-management hires this month that also saw Perigon Wealth Management add a chief people officer role.

headline: Insurity Elevates Jatin Atre to CEO, Commits $100M to AI Core Systems
summary: MGA and broker technology vendor Insurity promoted President Jatin Atre to chief executive, with predecessor Jeff Clarke moving to executive chairman, alongside a fresh $100 million pledge over two years toward AI-embedded core-system modernization.

headline: Acrisure Bolts On Four UK Brokers and an MGA in Specialist Push
summary: Acrisure's UK broking arm acquired retail brokers Heathwoods, Marrs and Smith Greenfield along with London MGA Confidas, broadening its commercial, property, high-net-worth and heritage-risk capabilities amid continued UK broker consolidation.

headline: UK Broker Consolidators Keep Buying as Independent Mid-Market Firms Shrink
summary: Private-equity-backed UK broker groups continue snapping up smaller firms, with Clear's purchase of Pangea Insurance Brokers and Pangea Life and Seventeen Group's acquisition of 1st Choice Insurance among recent deals, as nearly a third of once mid-sized independents have now sold.

headline: Cyber-Focused MGA Trivora Lands Growth Investment From Carroll Street Capital
summary: Specialty cyber MGA Trivora secured a growth capital investment led by private equity firm Carroll Street Capital, giving it fresh funding to expand into additional specialty insurance lines.

headline: APAC Warranty & Indemnity Insurance Claims Surge as Rates Hit Record Lows
summary: Data from Aon, Marsh and Gallagher show APAC transactional-risk insurance claim notifications jumped 76% year-on-year in 2025, with Marsh clients alone collecting over $80 million in payouts even as W&I and tax liability premium rates sank to record lows.

headline: India's Centricity Banks $33M to Scale Wealth Distribution Platform
