headline: WellSky debuts dashboards aimed at cutting delayed hospital discharges
summary: Home-health and care-transition software vendor WellSky launched Care Transition Intelligence Dashboards, designed to turn discharge-planning data into actionable insights for hospitals and post-acute providers.

headline: Black Book flags Europe's highest-risk hospital markets for cyberattacks
summary: A new Black Book Research report on Europe's healthcare cybersecurity hotspots identifies the continent's most exposed hospital markets, citing ransomware, thin supplier diversity and slow recovery as recurring risks to patient safety.

headline: Gallagher maps how AI and shifting demand are reshaping life and annuity carriers
summary: A Gallagher analysis of the life and annuities sector highlights how carriers are adopting AI-driven underwriting and product innovation to respond to changing consumer expectations and demographic shifts.

headline: Tiptree re-enters specialty P&C with $100 million Universal Shield acquisition
summary: Tiptree Inc. agreed to acquire Universal Shield Insurance Group, a specialty P&C insurer writing admitted and excess & surplus lines, for $100 million in cash, redeploying capital from its earlier Fortegra sale into a new specialty platform.

headline: Skyward Group's longtime CFO to retire, deputy CFO named successor
summary: Skyward Group announced that CFO Mark Haushill will retire in March 2027, with Taryn McHarg, currently deputy CFO, set to succeed him in the specialty P&C insurer's finance leadership.
source_name: SEC EDGAR / Skyward Specialty Insurance Group Form 8-K

headline: Property catastrophe reinsurance rates keep falling as capital hits record highs
summary: Property catastrophe reinsurance pricing fell 15-20% across many program layers at the mid-2026 renewals as global reinsurer capital climbed to a record roughly $790 billion, driven largely by growing third-party capital.

headline: High earners face mandatory Roth catch-up contributions under new 2026 rule
summary: Starting in 2026, workers 50 and older earning above roughly $150,000 from an employer must direct catch-up 401(k) contributions to Roth (after-tax) accounts rather than pre-tax, under a SECURE 2.0 provision taking effect this year.

headline: PLANADVISER tracks a fresh wave of retirement-advisory M&A deals
summary: PLANADVISER's mid-August roundup of retirement-plan advisory mergers shows deal activity continuing at a steady clip, as aggregators keep adding retirement-focused RIAs and advisory teams.

headline: Insurer sues TPA operators over $2.48 million in unpaid claims left languishing
summary: An insurer filed suit against the owners of a third-party administrator, alleging the TPA left roughly 900 claims unprocessed while still collecting fees, exposing the insurer to an estimated $2.48 million in owed payouts.

headline: AE Wealth Management names Shannon Larson president in push toward $250B goal
summary: AE Wealth Management appointed Shannon Larson as president, tasked with scaling its roughly $52 billion RIA network of 600 advisors toward a stated goal of $250 billion in assets by 2035 through organic growth and technology investment.

headline: FCA wealth management survey pushes discretionary managers on tech and governance
summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority published a wealth management survey report urging discretionary portfolio managers to use technology responsibly, tighten financial-crime controls and ensure governance keeps pace with growth.

headline: Australia's Steadfast agrees to $5.5 billion buyout by KKR-backed consortium
summary: Steadfast Group agreed to an A$7.7 billion buyout by a consortium of KKR, Amwins Group and Dragoneer Investment Group, with Amwins taking the underwriting agency business and Dragoneer the broking operations; shareholders get A$6 per share, a roughly 52% premium, with completion targeted for December 2026.

headline: IRDAI grants registration to Prudential HCL, India's 8th standalone health insurer
summary: India's insurance regulator issued a certificate of registration to Prudential HCL Health Insurance, a joint venture 70%-owned by UK-based Prudential and 30%-owned by HCL Group, bringing the number of standalone health insurers in India to eight.

headline: UnitedHealth leads Q2 payer profits as insurers show signs of cost recovery
summary: UnitedHealth Group posted $5.48 billion in Q2 2026 profit (a 4.9% margin), followed by Cigna at $1.66 billion and Centene at $1.09 billion, while Elevance Health was the only major insurer among the six tracked to post a year-over-year profit decline.

headline: ACA individual market risk pool grows smaller and sicker as enhanced subsidies expire
summary: With enhanced ACA premium tax credits expiring, healthier enrollees have been leaving the marketplaces, and analysts estimate enrollment fell 17-26% in 2026 while morbidity worsened 2.9-6.5%, pushing insurers to build 2027 rates on a smaller, less healthy risk pool.

headline: Mount Sinai quietly stops taking some new patients on Medicaid and Medicare Advantage plans
summary: Mount Sinai Health System removed notices -- after a Politico inquiry -- showing it had stopped accepting new patients under Centene's Fidelis Care and Wellcare Medicare Advantage plans, plus EmblemHealth Medicaid products, as of Aug. 1, while continuing to treat existing patients on those plans.

headline: HIMSS and SingHealth host APAC Health Conference in Singapore to accelerate AI-enabled care
summary: HIMSS and SingHealth co-hosted the 2026 HIMSS APAC Health Conference & Exhibition Aug. 23-25 in Singapore, gathering health ministries and digital-health leaders from South Korea, Australia and across the region around clinical AI, smart hospitals and interoperability.

headline: Oracle Health expands Clinical AI Agent with coding, dictation and chart review
summary: Oracle Health added professional-fee coding, clinician-controlled dictation and cross-record chart review to its Clinical AI Agent, aiming to cut documentation time, speed visit prep and improve reimbursement accuracy for health systems.

headline: Northwell's $1.2 billion Epic rollout reaches next phase with Central Region go-live
summary: Northwell Health's phased effort to unify more than 30 legacy EHRs across 28 hospitals onto a single Epic platform continues, with its Central Region wave -- one of the largest go-lives in Epic's history -- covering more than $8 billion in revenue and 40,000 simultaneous users.

headline: Weekly clinical AI use nearly doubles among doctors and nurses, Wolters Kluwer finds
summary: A Wolters Kluwer Health 2026 survey found nearly three-quarters of doctors and 70% of nurses now use AI at least weekly at work, up sharply from 38% and 46% respectively a year earlier.

headline: HHS announces $102 million to expand community health centers
summary: HHS awarded $102 million in New Access Points funding on Aug. 13 to expand the Health Center Program, aiming to bring primary care access to nearly 1 million more Americans.

headline: AI captures 99.1% of Q2 2026 global InsurTech funding
summary: Global InsurTech funding reached $2.44 billion in Q2 2026, with AI-focused companies pulling in $2.42 billion of that total, as investors keep raising the bar on how quickly AI insurtechs must show a path to profitability.

headline: Northern Trust survey of 180+ insurers flags AI 'hallucination' worries even as adoption accelerates
summary: A new Northern Trust report examining how more than 180 insurance asset owners are navigating investment strategy and operational challenges found three-fifths of asset managers worry about AI 'hallucinations' even as adoption of AI tools accelerates across the industry.

headline: Unaffiliated insurance general account assets hit record $5.5 trillion
summary: CWAN's 2026 Insurance Asset Management Trends report found unaffiliated general account AUM managed by 96 specialist managers reached a record $5.5 trillion at year-end 2025, with insurers continuing to tilt toward private credit and alternative assets even as public fixed income stays dominant.

headline: India opens insurance sector to 100% foreign direct investment under automatic route
summary: India's finance ministry amended foreign-exchange rules to permit 100% FDI in Indian insurance companies under the automatic route, extending the higher cap to brokers, reinsurance brokers, agents and other intermediaries while keeping state-run LIC capped at 20%.

headline: Catastrophe reinsurance prices post steepest annual drop in 25 years
summary: Global property-catastrophe reinsurance prices fell 16% year-on-year at the June/July renewals -- the largest annual decline since the late 1990s -- as record capital levels pressured pricing even as storm frequency and severity keep climbing.

headline: Global commercial insurance rates fall for 8th straight quarter, Marsh finds
summary: Marsh's Q2 2026 Global Insurance Market Index recorded a 6% average decline in commercial insurance rates worldwide, with property down 12% and cyber down 4%, while U.S. casualty bucked the trend with a 7% increase amid persistent claims-cost pressure.

headline: DOL proposal would open 401(k) plans to private-market investments
summary: A new Department of Labor proposal would let 401(k) fiduciaries add private-market investments to plan lineups, setting out 'safe harbor' steps for selecting such alternatives, building on the direction SECURE 2.0 had already signaled.

headline: Pension buy-in interest rates hit highest levels since 2023 as PRT market builds momentum
summary: Duration-7 and duration-15 annuity purchase interest rates have climbed to their highest points since 2023, and with pension liabilities declining, an August pricing update from October Three says conditions remain favorable for plan sponsors pursuing de-risking deals through the third quarter.

headline: Marpai projects positive cash flow starting August as TPA and PBM member base surges
summary: Marpai said an estimated 192,000 new member lives are rolling onto its TPA and MarpaiRx PBM platforms between August 2026 and January 2027 -- nearly a six-fold increase -- positioning the company to reach positive cash flow and EBITDA beginning this month.

headline: TPA software market on pace to more than double by 2034 amid AI-driven claims push
summary: The global third-party-administrator software market is projected to grow from $4.8 billion in 2025 to $10.2 billion by 2034, an 8.7% CAGR, as AI-driven claims automation and rising self-funded enrollment push carriers and employers toward outsourced TPA platforms.

headline: Carson Group adds $405 million Atlanta team from Northwestern Mutual
summary: Carson Group welcomed Yari Capital, a $405 million Atlanta advisory practice led by CFP Kurt Mattson, to its independent advisor channel, continuing a run of recruiting wins for the $62 billion RIA aggregator.

headline: Wealth Enhancement acquires Oklahoma City's Servo Wealth Management
summary: Wealth Enhancement acquired the investment advisory business of Servo Wealth Management, an Oklahoma City RIA managing more than $210 million for physicians, attorneys and business owners, deepening the Minneapolis consolidator's presence in the South-Central U.S.

headline: Orion launches fractional share trading for advisors custodying with Schwab
summary: Orion rolled out fractional share trading built into its order management system for RIAs custodying with Schwab Advisor Services, letting advisors implement model allocations to the dollar instead of rounding to whole shares.

headline: Asset Vantage names Nicole Eberhardt global CEO to lead wealthtech expansion
summary: Family-office wealthtech platform Asset Vantage, which supports more than $400 billion in assets across 400-plus families in 10 countries, appointed Nicole Eberhardt as global CEO effective August 1, elevating its former North America managing director to lead product and market expansion.

headline: Aon poaches Marsh's Southeast Asia chief executive
summary: Aon hired Godelieve van Dooren, Marsh's Singapore-based chief executive for Southeast Asia, succeeding Andrew Minitt, who left earlier this year to lead The Ardonagh Group's Asia business.

headline: UnitedHealth tops Q2 estimates and raises full-year guidance on cost control
summary: UnitedHealth posted a $5.5 billion second-quarter profit and again raised its 2026 earnings outlook, even as executives cautioned that easing commercial medical cost trends reflect active cost management rather than a durable trend reversal.

headline: Medicare Advantage loss ratios climbed to a five-year high in 2025
summary: A market review finds Medicare Advantage combined loss ratios reached 90.3% in 2025, the highest in five years, adding pressure on insurer margins even as 2026 rate adjustments are expected to offer some relief.

headline: Maine regulators approve York Hospital's merger into MaineHealth
summary: State regulators approved York Hospital's merger with MaineHealth after the community hospital said financial strain, including an $11 million operating loss, left it unable to keep operating independently.

headline: Lemonade extends its Tesla Full Self-Driving insurance discount to Tennessee
summary: Lemonade brought its Autonomous Car product, which gives Tesla owners 50% off insurance costs for miles driven under Full Self-Driving supervision, to Tennessee, its fifth state since the January 2026 launch.

headline: Asia-Pacific reinsurers post 4% revenue growth, reversing prior-year decline
summary: A.M. Best reports Asia-Pacific reinsurers grew net insurance service revenue 4% year-on-year in 2025, snapping a prior decline, with earnings supported by a heavier mix of non-proportional overseas treaty business.

headline: M&G shares steady as insurer sets sights on annual bulk annuity sales growth
summary: M&G's stock held firm in late August as the insurer pushes deeper into the UK bulk annuity market, targeting £3-4 billion in annual sales by 2027 while investors watch for stabilization in its asset management arm.

headline: LIC posts 23% profit jump in Q1 as new business value surges 61%
summary: India's Life Insurance Corporation reported a 23% year-on-year rise in net profit to roughly Rs 13,492 crore for the June quarter, with value of new business up 61% and premium income growing nearly 7%.

headline: US commercial P&C rate declines accelerate in the second quarter
summary: The Council's benchmark survey shows commercial property-casualty premiums fell an average 2.0% in the first half of 2026, with large accounts seeing the steepest rate relief as capacity keeps expanding.

headline: Progressive names former 3M executive to succeed retiring chief marketing officer
summary: Progressive Insurance named a former 3M executive as its new chief marketing officer, succeeding the auto and property insurer's retiring CMO.

headline: Principal expands its 401(k) platform to private-market investment strategies
summary: Principal broadened its Featured Partner Programme so asset managers including Apollo, Blackstone, KKR and Carlyle can offer private-market strategies inside target-date and target-risk collective investment trusts on its recordkeeping platform.

headline: Marpai projects positive cash flow this month on nearly six-fold TPA and PBM membership growth
summary: Third-party administrator and PBM Marpai said roughly 192,000 new member lives rolling on through January 2027, including 35,000 TPA lives live August 1, should drive the company to positive cash flow and EBITDA starting in August 2026.

headline: Vanguard agrees to acquire wealthtech custodian Altruist
summary: Vanguard signed a definitive agreement to acquire Altruist, an AI-forward wealth technology and custody platform for advisors, in a deal reported at roughly $4-4.6 billion; Altruist is expected to keep operating under its own brand.

headline: Keylane acquires UK claims-tech specialist 360Globalnet to bolster its P&C offering
summary: Dutch insurance software provider Keylane bought 360Globalnet, adding its no-code SiteView digital claims platform to help insurers automate claims workflows and digital site visits across Europe, APAC and North America.

headline: Fidelity to add a guaranteed-income sleeve to its Freedom target-date fund lineup
summary: Fidelity is expanding its Freedom Lifetime series with an insurance-backed guaranteed income option supported by Nationwide and New York Life, blending active and index funds ahead of an early-2027 rollout.

headline: 1891 Financial Life rolls out a new digital annuity application built with iCover and Solvrays
summary: The insurer launched an eApp designed to simplify and speed up annuity application and submission for agents and clients, part of a broader digital modernization push across the life and annuity sector.

headline: Global P&C reinsurers enter H2 2026 well capitalized but facing softer pricing
summary: Morningstar DBRS says record reinsurance capital chasing only modest demand growth is pushing property catastrophe rates lower, with further softening likely into 2027 absent a major loss event.

headline: AI advisor tools keep multiplying as Kitces tracks a wave of August product launches
summary: Kitces' August AdvisorTech roundup highlights a new Zeplyn integration with Schwab Advisor Center, Feathery's $30 million raise for workflow automation, and fresh Series A rounds for AI-powered compliance startups Hadrius and Greenboard.

headline: The Brokerage Inc. becomes first Strategic-level partner in AgencyBloc's partner program
summary: The Brokerage, Inc. joined AgencyBloc's Partner Program as its first Strategic-level charter member, giving downline agencies preferred access to AgencyBloc's agency management technology for streamlining operations and automating commissions in health and life distribution.

headline: MassMutual Ascend surpasses $2 billion in lifetime advisory annuity sales
summary: MassMutual Ascend said its advisory annuity sales have crossed $2 billion, built on relationships with more than 1,700 investment advisor representatives across nearly 1,000 RIAs, with roughly $900 million of that total coming in 2025 and 2026 alone.

headline: Chubb pursues insurance market's first annual aggregate cyber catastrophe bond
summary: Chubb is seeking annual aggregate cyber reinsurance protection through a new East Lane Re VII catastrophe bond, which would become the first aggregate cyber cat bond in the market's history as capital markets take on more cyber-loss risk.

headline: State Farm begins distributing promised $5 billion in policyholder dividends
summary: State Farm started distributing $5 billion in previously announced dividends to eligible policyholders, part of the mutual insurer's broader capital-return efforts detailed in PropertyCasualty360's industry roundup.

headline: UK PRA finalizes Solvency UK reporting and disclosure overhaul
summary: The Bank of England's Prudential Regulation Authority published PS18/26, finalizing amendments to Solvency UK reporting and disclosure rules, including moving a key matching-adjustment return to XBRL format, with insurers required to comply for reporting dates from December 31, 2026.

headline: Vanguard readies first new target-date series since 2003 with built-in TIAA annuity
summary: Vanguard is rolling out Target Retirement Lifetime Income Trusts that begin allocating to the TIAA Secure Income Account at age 55, reaching about 25% of the portfolio by 65, giving 401(k) participants an optional guaranteed-income sleeve within the same glide path as its flagship funds.

headline: Epic Retirement Solutions acquires recordkeeper Retirement Direct
summary: Retirement plan services firm Epic Retirement Solutions acquired recordkeeping provider Retirement Direct, adding to a wave of consolidation among smaller defined-contribution recordkeepers as fee pressure pushes the industry toward scale.

headline: Rising costs push employers to lean harder on broker-TPA partnerships
summary: Employee Benefit News reports that rising healthcare costs and limited internal HR capacity are driving employers to demand stronger broker-TPA partnerships capable of executing complex cost-containment strategies, as TPAs take on expanded analytics and compliance roles.

headline: RIA channel keeps pulling senior talent from banking and asset management
summary: Three wealth management firms announced senior hires spanning investment banking, alternative investment distribution and sports and entertainment wealth management, including Guggenheim Securities naming Blake Jones a senior managing director focused on M&A involving RIAs and broker-dealers.

headline: Wealth Enhancement extends acquisition streak with $644 million Washington state RIA
summary: Wealth Enhancement acquired Olympia, Washington-based Weinand Financial, an independent RIA with about $644 million in client assets, pushing the consolidator's total client assets past $160.7 billion.

headline: Feathery launches AI proposal generator built for wealth management firms
summary: Wealthtech firm Feathery launched an AI-powered proposal generation tool, built around its assistant Robin, that pulls client data from Salesforce, eMoney, Holistiplan, Addepar and Morningstar to draft personalized, compliance-ready proposals for advisors.

headline: American Growth Insurance launches AI-enabled brokerage growth platform with $70 million backing
summary: American Growth Insurance launched an AI-enabled insurance brokerage growth platform with nearly $70 million in committed equity funding from Rockbridge Growth Equity and venture studio Atomic.

headline: Top five MGA groups now control nearly a fifth of a $17 billion global market
summary: Brown & Brown, Truist Insurance Holdings, Amwins, Ryan Specialty and Gallagher lead the global MGA, MGU and cover-holder market, which grew roughly 19% to about $17.3 billion in revenue, with Brown & Brown alone topping $1 billion in delegated-underwriting revenue.

headline: CMS backs off proposed Medicare Advantage payment cut, raising 2027 rates nearly 5%
summary: CMS finalized Medicare Advantage payment rates for 2027 well above its initial proposal, delivering private insurers close to a 5% average per-enrollee increase after industry pushback on planned cuts.

headline: Insurer exits keep thinning Medicare Advantage options for enrollees
summary: Becker's Payer Issues tracks a continuing pattern of Medicare Advantage insurer exits and pullbacks in 2026, with a JAMA study finding roughly 10% of MA enrollees had to disenroll and find new coverage after their plans left the market.

headline: Innovaccer and AWS strike multi-year deal to scale agentic AI across health systems
summary: Innovaccer and Amazon Web Services signed a multi-year strategic collaboration aimed at helping health systems and payers move agentic AI from pilot projects into deployments that meet security, compliance and scale requirements.

headline: Exer AI expands Mayo Clinic partnership to widen clinical AI tool deployment
summary: Exer AI broadened its partnership with Mayo Clinic to further integrate its AI-powered movement-assessment technology into orthopaedic clinical workflows.

headline: Carpe launches Minerva Reasoning Engine to help small commercial insurers underwrite profitably
summary: AI-native data specialist Carpe introduced its Minerva Reasoning Engine, an underwriting tool aimed specifically at helping small commercial insurers price risk more profitably.

headline: Tokio Marine takes minority stake in Singapore insurtech Igloo
summary: Tokio Marine invested about $5 million for a 1.65% equity stake in Igloo, a full-stack insurtech operating across eight Southeast Asian markets, extending the Japanese carrier's push deeper into the region's digital insurance space.

headline: WisdomTree posts sixth straight quarter of record AUM at $162.9 billion
summary: WisdomTree's assets under management hit a record $162.9 billion in the second quarter, driven by the Atlantic House acquisition, market appreciation and $3.1 billion of net inflows, marking its sixth consecutive record quarter.

headline: Top MYGA fixed annuity rates push above 7% in late August
summary: The best available multi-year guaranteed annuity rate reached 7.20% simple interest (6.40% compound) on select terms as of August 27, with every rate change that week moving up rather than down even as the Federal Reserve holds a wait-and-see stance.

headline: State Farm raises Illinois home insurance rates 27% on rising claims costs
summary: State Farm is raising home insurance rates by an average of 27% for Illinois customers, saying it paid out $1.26 in total costs for every $1 collected in premium in 2024, even as the insurer separately lowers Illinois auto rates.

headline: GEICO names Nancy Pierce CEO as insurance leadership shuffle continues
summary: GEICO appointed Nancy L. Pierce as chief executive, one of several August leadership changes across the industry that also saw Boston Mutual Life name Grant David Ward CEO and Conduit Holdings name Mark Pickering as incoming CFO.

headline: TPAs push beyond claims handling into prevention and AI-powered risk management
summary: Gallagher Bassett argues third-party administrators are shifting from reactive claims processing toward proactive risk prevention, pre-loss consulting and AI-driven claims tools as carriers face rising claim severity and complexity.

headline: Apollon and Merit extend RIA buying spree with two more acquisitions
summary: Apollon Wealth Management added a roughly $650 million RIA while Merit Financial Advisors picked up a $470 million advisory firm, the latest moves in an accelerating wave of RIA consolidation.

headline: MissionSquare pushes beyond retirement plans into personal wealth management
summary: MissionSquare, long focused on public-sector retirement plans, launched a personal wealth management business and rebranded its broker-dealer subsidiary as MissionSquare Wealth Management, naming Shannon Hogendorn as president.

headline: Higginbotham joins forces with Two West Capital Advisors to grow retirement plan business
summary: The Fort Worth-based brokerage, ranked 16th-largest in the US, is bringing the Kansas City retirement-plan consulting and wealth management firm's team into its retirement and wealth division, with Two West staying in Kansas City as employee-owners of Higginbotham.

headline: Hong Kong curbs first-year insurance commissions amid soaring mainland demand
summary: The city's insurance authority tightened first-year commission structures for its more than 800 licensed broker companies as mainland Chinese buyers continue to drive a surge in long-term policy sales.

headline: Hong Kong's new crypto rules could open an $82 billion insurance opportunity
summary: New digital-asset regulation in Hong Kong is creating a potential market for insurers to cover crypto custody, exchange and institutional-holding risk, as the territory positions itself as a digital-asset hub.

headline: NewYork-Presbyterian and UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage contract set to lapse August 31
summary: After repeated extensions since a January deadline, the hospital system and insurer face an August 31 cutoff that would push most UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage members out of network, part of a wider pattern of health-system/payer contract breaks in 2026.

headline: CMS finalizes FY2027 hospital payment rule with 2.3% rate increase
summary: The final inpatient prospective payment system rule raises Medicare hospital payments by about $2.1 billion in fiscal 2027 for facilities meeting quality-reporting and EHR requirements, while trimming disproportionate-share hospital payments by $200 million.

headline: York Hospital-MaineHealth merger clears state approval, set to close October 1
summary: Maine regulators approved the merger after York Hospital said it could no longer operate independently amid rising labor and supply costs, with conditions barring service cuts in southern York County for three years without state notice.

headline: Clinician AI use triples as 74% of doctors and 70% of nurses adopt weekly
summary: A new report finds daily multiple-times-per-day AI use has tripled among doctors and doubled among nurses since 2025, driven by generative AI breakthroughs, near-universal EHR adoption and surging institutional investment in cognitive-computing infrastructure.

headline: Thoma Bravo to take specialty insurer Accelerant private in $4 billion-plus deal
summary: The software-focused investment firm agreed to buy the Accelerant Risk Exchange platform for $20.25 a share in cash, a 49% premium, with Accelerant's largest investor and founders keeping equity alongside Thoma Bravo.

headline: Global reinsurance capital hits record $790 billion as catastrophe bond issuance sets first-half record
summary: Guy Carpenter data show reinsurer capacity and abundant risk appetite pushed cat bond issuance to an all-time first-half high of $17.3 billion, while property catastrophe rates fell the most since the late 1990s at mid-year renewals.

headline: Corebridge Financial and Equitable Holdings name leadership team as $22 billion merger advances
summary: The two insurers announced the executive team that will run the combined retirement, life, wealth and asset management company after shareholders of both firms approved the all-stock deal in late July.

headline: Wawanesa Insurance rebrands as W Insurance in its California personal-lines business
summary: The San Diego-based carrier, acquired by the Automobile Club of Southern California's affiliated insurer in 2024, shortened its name for its roughly 300,000 auto, home, condo and renters policies, with no change to coverage, claims or servicing.

headline: Calaveras County wildfire burns over 10,000 acres, affecting more than 64,000 policyholders
summary: A California wildfire that broke out earlier in the month has scorched over 10,000 acres and touched more than 64,000 policyholders, as the NAIC's summer national meeting took up property-casualty issues the same week.

headline: EIOPA elects Bank of Greece supervisor Stavros Konstantas to its Management Board
summary: Konstantas, director of occupational and private insurance supervision at the Bank of Greece, begins a two-and-a-half-year term on the EU insurance and pensions regulator's board, succeeding Ante Zigman after his move to lead Croatia's central bank.

headline: DC plan sponsors show rising appetite for alternative investments as DOL rule advances
summary: New research finds 44% of defined-contribution plan sponsors want to learn more about adding alternatives to 401(k) lineups, with large and mega plans most interested, as the Department of Labor works through a proposed fiduciary safe harbor for the asset class.

headline: Retirement income council calls decumulation the next frontier for defined-contribution plans
summary: The Institutional Retirement Income Council outlined five moves plan sponsors should make now to help participants convert savings into retirement income, as the industry's attention shifts from asset accumulation to drawdown.

headline: Healthcare Management Administrators names Diane Zalewski CEO
summary: The third-party administrator serving self-funded employers hired Zalewski, formerly president of Payer Solutions at Evernorth, where she ran a business serving health plans, TPAs and employer clients.

headline: MAI Capital enters Atlanta market with $490 million Waypoint Wealth Counsel acquisition
summary: The Cleveland-based RIA, backed by a recent Carlyle investment, added the fee-only Atlanta firm and its more than 100 households, giving Waypoint's founders access to MAI's family-office platform, lending and alternative-investment sourcing.

headline: Savvy adds Blue Barn Wealth and Paragon Private Wealth, crossing $8 billion in AUM
summary: The two independent firms bring roughly $550 million in combined assets to Savvy's network, part of a run that has brought in over $4 billion in recruited assets in 2026 and quadrupled the platform's total AUM year over year.

headline: Kestra Financial names ex-BlackRock executive Kelly Apple as head of wealth management
summary: Apple, who spent more than 13 years at BlackRock and previously held senior roles at DWS and Van Kampen, will lead Kestra's investment management, high-net-worth, retirement and insurance, and alternative-investment teams.

headline: Willis Re to acquire BMS Group's US reinsurance division
summary: Willis Re agreed to buy the US reinsurance broking and capital-advisory business of BMS Group, including its catastrophe bond and ILS team, marking Willis Re's first major deal since its relaunch.

headline: WTW completes $1.3 billion acquisition of tech-enabled broker Newfront
summary: Willis Towers Watson finalized its purchase of Newfront Insurance Holdings for $1.3 billion, adding the San Francisco-based broker's technology-driven middle-market and specialty business to its Risk & Broking and Health, Wealth & Career units.

headline: TWFG expands agency footprint with Iowa-based Fortress Insurance Services deal
summary: TWFG completed its acquisition of Fortress Insurance Services, an independent Iowa agency, effective May 1, 2026, continuing a string of tuck-in agency and MGA purchases this year.

headline: MGA deal-making accelerates as carriers and private equity chase scale
summary: Mergers and acquisitions among managing general agencies have picked up in both number and size, with carriers and private-equity investors increasingly pursuing MGA platforms as specialty and E&S business keeps growing.

headline: CMS finalizes 2027 Medicare Advantage rate hike alongside tighter prior-authorization rules
summary: CMS finalized a 2.48% increase to 2027 Medicare Advantage payments, worth more than $13 billion, while its 2026 final rule requires MA and Part D plans to decide expedited prior-authorization requests within 72 hours.

headline: CVS Health tops Q2 estimates and lifts guidance as Aetna shows signs of recovery
summary: CVS Health beat second-quarter earnings and revenue estimates and raised its 2026 guidance as its Aetna insurance unit continued to recover, though shares slipped after the company flagged expected membership declines at Caremark.

headline: India's health insurance premiums jump 27% on digital distribution and NRI demand
summary: Indian health insurance premiums grew 27.2% year-on-year in January 2026, with standalone health insurers up 32.3%, as digital distribution and a 126% surge in NRI purchases of Indian health cover fueled growth.

headline: Singapore refreshes AI-in-healthcare guidelines with bias and performance monitoring rules
summary: Singapore's Ministry of Health and Health Sciences Authority published updated AI in Healthcare Guidelines requiring ongoing validation, performance monitoring and bias detection for clinical AI tools deployed in the city-state.

headline: AI-labeled insurtechs capture 99% of second-quarter funding as early-stage deals cool
summary: AI-focused insurtechs absorbed 99.1% of all Q2 2026 insurtech funding, or $2.42 billion, even as early-stage deal activity slowed, extending a run in which AI has dominated investor interest in the sector.

headline: Satellite radar startup ICEYE raises over €1 billion, valuation tops €10 billion
summary: Finnish satellite-imaging company ICEYE raised more than €1 billion in a General Atlantic-led Series F round, pushing its valuation above €10 billion as it doubles annual satellite production for sovereign and insurance risk clients.

headline: Assurant's net investment income jumps 19% in first half of 2026
summary: Assurant reported net investment income of $302.0 million for the first six months of 2026, up from $253.5 million a year earlier, driven by higher yields and larger fixed-maturity holdings.

headline: Jackson National reportedly weighing acquisition of a life insurer
summary: Jackson Financial is said to be exploring the purchase of a life insurance carrier as it looks to broaden its product lineup beyond its core variable-annuity business.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance hits record $24.9 billion as alternative capital tops $144 billion
summary: Aon's latest Insurance-Linked Securities report shows catastrophe bond issuance reached an all-time high of $24.9 billion over the year to June 30, 2026, pushing total alternative reinsurance capital to a record $144.5 billion.

headline: Cyber insurance pricing keeps softening even as third-party claims climb 30%
summary: The US cyber insurance market logged an eighth straight quarter of pricing cuts even as third-party claims rose roughly 30%, a trend likely to pressure loss ratios given the longer tail on such claims.

headline: Bank of England's new insurer liquidity reporting rules take effect September 30
summary: New Bank of England liquidity reporting requirements for large UK Solvency II insurers with significant derivatives or securities-lending exposure come into force on September 30, 2026, closing a gap flagged in an earlier PRA consultation.

headline: AIG names Nancy Bewlay global chief underwriting officer
summary: AIG appointed Nancy Bewlay, formerly AXA's group chief underwriting and pricing officer, as executive vice president and global chief underwriting officer effective September 8, 2026, reporting to CEO Eric Andersen.

headline: US employer retirement plan assets climb to $13.8 trillion
summary: Investment Company Institute data show Americans held $13.8 trillion across employer-sponsored defined contribution plans as of March 31, 2026, with $9.9 trillion of that in 401(k) accounts alone.

headline: DOL proposes first federal fee-disclosure rule targeting PBMs and TPAs
summary: The US Department of Labor proposed a rule that would require pharmacy benefit managers and third-party administrators to give employer-sponsored ERISA health plans detailed advance disclosure of the fees they charge.

headline: AI-native advisor platform Jump raises $80 million Series B
summary: Jump, an AI platform for financial advisors, raised an $80 million Series B led by Insight Partners with participation from F-Prime Capital and Allianz Life Ventures, four times the size of its Series A.

headline: Aon agrees to buy rival broker USI from KKR for $17 billion
summary: Aon confirmed a deal to acquire middle-market insurance broker USI Insurance Services from KKR for about $17 billion including debt, aiming to build what CEO Greg Case called a "premier" US middle-market platform.

headline: Brokers rate the MGAs that stood out in 2026 in Insurance Business Canada's annual review
summary: Insurance Business Canada opened its 10th annual Brokers on MGAs evaluation, inviting brokers to score managing general agents on underwriting responsiveness, technical expertise, compensation and claims support.

headline: Embedded finance's growth collides with a regulatory reckoning
summary: As embedded finance and insurance partnerships proliferate, regulators are increasing scrutiny of sponsor-bank and fintech partnerships, with compliance violations already costing many sponsor banks over $100,000 each.

headline: NatWest launches embedded home insurance through Uinsure partnership
summary: UK bank NatWest rolled out a new home insurance offering built on Manchester-based insurtech Uinsure's digital infrastructure, part of a broader wave of embedded-insurance partnerships between banks and insurtechs this year.

headline: Innovaccer and AWS sign multi-year deal to scale agentic AI across health systems
summary: Innovaccer and AWS announced a strategic collaboration pairing Innovaccer's healthcare AI platform with AWS infrastructure, including Bedrock and HealthLake, to help health systems and payers move AI pilots into production faster.

headline: IRDAI proposes a nationwide Public Insurance Registry to digitize India's insurance ecosystem
summary: India's insurance regulator released a consultation paper proposing a population-scale Public Insurance Registry connecting insurers, intermediaries, reinsurers and policyholders through a single interoperable digital framework.

headline: Insurtech Corgi triples valuation to $4 billion in third raise in eight weeks
summary: AI-native insurance carrier Corgi reportedly raised fresh capital at a $4 billion valuation, its third funding round in eight weeks after earlier rounds at $1.3 billion and $2.6 billion.

headline: AIG leans further into private assets to offset softening investment income
summary: AIG plans to raise its allocation to private assets as it looks to reaccelerate net investment income growth, which the insurer expects to resume by 2027.

headline: BCG says asset managers need a new growth playbook as fee pressure mounts
summary: Boston Consulting Group's 2026 global asset management report argues the industry must rethink its economics as traditional fee-based growth slows and firms turn to alternatives and AI for margin.

headline: Japan's largest life insurers report $96 billion in unrealized bond losses
summary: Japan's four biggest life insurers saw combined paper losses on domestic bond holdings swell 7% in the quarter through June, underscoring the strain rising global yields are putting on insurer balance sheets.

headline: Qumis launches attorney-certified AI agents for commercial coverage analysis
summary: Insurtech Qumis rolled out specialist AI agents covering 16 lines of commercial insurance that analyze full programs and produce citation-backed coverage conclusions, already in use at several of the largest US brokers.

headline: UK's FCA lays out 2026 insurance supervision priorities in first annual report
summary: The Financial Conduct Authority published its first annual insurance-sector regulatory priorities report, consolidating prior portfolio letters and putting claims handling and access to insurance for vulnerable consumers at the center.

headline: TIAA and Nuveen's lifetime-income target-date funds cross 1,000 employer plans
summary: TIAA and Nuveen said their suite of target-date funds with built-in annuity options, including TIAA RetirePlus and the Nuveen Lifecycle Income CIT series, has now been adopted by more than 1,000 employer retirement plans.

headline: PLANSPONSOR survey finds recordkeepers still lag on integrated financial-wellness benefits
summary: The 2026 PLANSPONSOR Recordkeeping Survey found only a fifth of recordkeepers let plan sponsors choose from multiple integrated student-loan repayment programs, with many offering just one option or none.

headline: Sequoia Financial expands in Colorado with $2.3 billion RIA acquisition
summary: Akron-based Sequoia Financial Group, which manages $34.9 billion in assets, acquired Colorado registered investment advisor BSW Wealth Partners in its latest consolidation move.

headline: Advisors take a cautious approach to AI tools despite a crowded wealthtech field
summary: At the Future Proof Citywide conference in Miami, 86 wealthtech firms competed for demo slots spanning CRM, tax planning, compliance and agentic AI assistants, but advisors said they remain cautious about full-scale adoption.

headline: India's wealth managers grapple with fragmented data as portfolios grow more complex
summary: Industry panelists at a Hubbis discussion said rapid wealth creation and intergenerational transfer are exposing gaps in Indian wealth managers' legacy data and operating systems, pushing firms toward consolidated platforms and AI tools.

headline: Caledon Group launches new MGA for complex UK and Ireland home insurance risks
summary: Caledon Group introduced Caledon MGA to write home insurance for unique, high-value, and non-standard household risks across the UK and Ireland, broadening its specialty property portfolio.

headline: Avantia adds Accredited Insurance UK as new co-insurer on its Homeprotect platform
summary: Avantia Group, parent of specialist home insurer Homeprotect, added Accredited Insurance (UK) Limited as a co-insurance partner, expanding underwriting capacity on its digital home insurance platform.

headline: Tech-enabled E&S managing general agent Aurenity lands growth investment from Great Hill Partners
summary: Aurenity, a Connecticut-based technology-enabled excess-and-surplus MGA, secured a strategic investment from private equity firm Great Hill Partners to widen its underwriting bench, launch new specialty programs, and build out automation infrastructure.

headline: UnitedHealth raises 2026 profit outlook after Q2 earnings beat expectations
summary: UnitedHealth Group lifted its full-year 2026 adjusted earnings guidance to $19.50-$20 per share, up from its prior forecast of more than $18.25, after second-quarter profit came in well ahead of Wall Street estimates.

headline: Health systems report major documentation-time savings from ambient AI scribes
summary: Intermountain Health cut time spent on visit notes by 27% and Cooper University Healthcare says clinicians are saving more than an hour of documentation time daily after deploying Microsoft's Dragon Copilot ambient AI scribe technology.

headline: HHS seeks public input on accelerating AI adoption across clinical care
summary: The Department of Health and Human Services issued a broad request for information asking how federal regulatory, reimbursement, and research powers could be used to speed the adoption of AI tools in clinical settings.

headline: Nirvana Insurance extends Series D by $100 million, lifting valuation to $1.5 billion
summary: Telematics-focused insurtech Nirvana Insurance raised a $100 million extension to its Series D round, pushing its valuation to $1.5 billion as it builds out an AI-powered operating system for commercial auto insurance.

headline: AI-native carrier Corgi raises $108 million and wins regulatory approval to underwrite startups
summary: Corgi secured $108 million in funding along with regulatory authority to operate as a full-stack, AI-native insurance carrier focused on startup companies, with plans to expand coverage options and invest further in underwriting and claims automation.

headline: Insurtech investors write fewer, much larger checks in 2026
summary: The median insurtech funding round size roughly doubled to $30 million in 2026 from $16.5 million a year earlier, as investors consolidate capital behind fewer companies with proven AI-driven underwriting or claims capabilities.

headline: Active fixed-income managers keep beating benchmarks inside target-date funds
summary: J.P. Morgan Asset Management research finds actively managed fixed-income sleeves inside target-date funds have outperformed their benchmarks net of fees in 94% of rolling three-year periods, reinforcing active management's role in DC default investments.

headline: LIMRA and LOMA anchor September's Life Insurance Awareness Month with a coverage-gap push
summary: LIMRA and LOMA are running a public-education campaign this Life Insurance Awareness Month aimed at highlighting how underinsured many American households remain and encouraging more people to evaluate life coverage needs.

headline: Sun Life and Wilton Re form strategic life and annuity reinsurance partnership, launching Windsor Life Re
summary: Sun Life and Wilton Re signed a definitive agreement combining reinsurance and asset-management capabilities across life and annuity blocks, with Wilton Re establishing the U.S./Bermuda-domiciled Windsor Life Re to support future in-force block origination.

headline: U.S. P&C insurers post sharply higher first-half 2026 underwriting gains as combined ratio improves
summary: The U.S. property/casualty industry's net underwriting gain nearly tripled to $31.7 billion in the first half of 2026 versus a year earlier, with the combined ratio improving to 92.7% even as premium growth slowed and casualty lines stayed under pressure.

headline: Verisk raises average annual insured catastrophe loss estimate to $171 billion
summary: Verisk's latest catastrophe modeling puts expected global insured catastrophe losses at $171 billion annually, up $19 billion from a year ago, underscoring the growing capital cushion insurers need to absorb severe weather and other disaster risk.

headline: Zurich and Farmers Exchanges to acquire MetLife's U.S. property and casualty business for $3.9 billion
summary: Zurich Insurance and the Farmers Exchanges agreed to buy MetLife's U.S. P&C operations for roughly $3.9 billion, part of a broader wave of targeted, capital-efficient consolidation among carriers this year.

headline: AI spending in P&C insurance set to triple in 2026, but most carriers still aren't capturing value at scale
summary: Industry surveys show property-casualty insurers tripling AI's share of technology spending in 2026, yet only about 38% report generating value at scale from AI in core underwriting and claims workflows, even as consumer resistance to AI-driven quotes keeps falling.

headline: AIG names Nancy Bewlay global chief underwriting officer
summary: AIG named Nancy Bewlay as executive vice president and global chief underwriting officer, effective September 8, as the insurer continues refreshing its underwriting leadership team.

headline: Guaranteed income options gain interest among DC plan sponsors, though adoption still lags
summary: A defined-contribution plan sponsor survey found growing interest in guaranteed retirement income options, but only 17% of sponsors said they are very or extremely likely to add one within the next 12-18 months, underscoring a gap between interest and adoption.

headline: SECURE 2.0's Roth catch-up contribution mandate takes effect for higher earners
summary: Starting January 1, 2026, SECURE 2.0 requires employees age 50-plus earning more than $150,000 in FICA wages to make catch-up 401(k) contributions on a Roth, after-tax basis, a compliance change employers spent the year preparing payroll and plan systems for.

headline: Vertafore launches Velocity AI Platform with agents built for agency and MGA workflows
summary: Vertafore introduced its Velocity AI Platform along with six purpose-built AI agents embedded directly into the core systems agencies, MGAs and carriers already use, part of a broader push to bring generative AI into everyday broker workflows.

headline: Aon agrees to buy broker USI from KKR in roughly $17 billion deal
summary: Aon announced it will acquire USI Insurance Services, the tenth-largest US insurance broker with about $3 billion in annual revenue, from private equity owner KKR for approximately $17 billion in cash, extending Aon's push into the US middle market following its 2024 purchase of NFP.

headline: Medicare Advantage industry gathers in San Diego for RISE West as plans prep for 2027
summary: More than 500 health plan executives, providers and policy experts convened at RISE West 2026 in San Diego from September 2-4 to focus on Medicare Advantage risk adjustment, quality performance, AI implementation and operational strategy ahead of 2027 bids.

headline: London NHS trust performs world-first AI-assisted brain surgery
summary: University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust says it carried out the world's first brain operation guided by real-time AI analysis of the surgical video feed, helping the surgical team identify critical structures while removing a pituitary tumor from a 48-year-old patient.

headline: UPMC to acquire CommonSpirit's Trinity Health System in Ohio Valley expansion
summary: UPMC reached an agreement to acquire CommonSpirit Health's Trinity Health System in Ohio, with the deal expected to close this fall as part of a broader rebound in hospital M&A activity that saw roughly 40 hospital deals in the first half of 2026.

headline: Zurich extends agentic AI underwriting platform toward more than 20 markets worldwide
summary: Zurich Insurance is scaling an AI risk-digitization platform built with insurtech Cytora to more than 20 countries over 16 months, after an initial five-country rollout cut manual submission triage time by roughly 80%, from 75 minutes to 15 minutes per case.

headline: French health insurtech Alan closes 480 million euro Series G at a 5.5 billion euro valuation
summary: Alan, the French digital health insurer and prevention platform, raised a 480 million euro Series G round led by Prosus, with participation from Index Ventures and Teachers' Venture Growth, just months after a prior 100 million euro round, as its annualized revenue passed 800 million euros.

headline: BlackRock's assets under management climb to $15.3 trillion in the second quarter
summary: BlackRock reported AUM of $15.3 trillion for Q2 2026, with net inflows of $192 billion in the quarter and $321 billion for the first half, driven by ETFs, private markets and systematic equity strategies.

headline: Selective Insurance's investment income jumps as reinvestment yields keep climbing
summary: Selective Insurance Group reported after-tax net investment income of $119 million for the second quarter, up 18% year-over-year, with its fixed-income portfolio yielding 4.4% as insurers keep benefiting from reinvesting maturing bonds at higher rates.

headline: LIMRA reports steady Q2 growth in life insurance sales, led by whole life and variable universal life
summary: LIMRA's Q2 2026 individual life insurance survey found total new premium rose 3% year-over-year to $4.75 billion, with whole life climbing 9% to become the largest driver of growth and variable universal life posting the fastest growth rate at 13%, aided by a rebound in equity markets.

headline: AIG hires AXA veteran Nancy Bewlay as global chief underwriting officer
summary: AIG named Nancy Bewlay, most recently AXA's group chief underwriting and pricing officer, as its new executive vice president and global chief underwriting officer effective September 8, bringing more than 30 years of underwriting leadership experience from AXA, Swiss Re and C.V. Starr.

headline: Canopius taps BCG's Nadine Moore to lead its US specialty insurance business
summary: Lloyd's specialty insurer Canopius Group named Nadine Moore, formerly a managing director and senior partner at Boston Consulting Group, as CEO of its US business effective this September, succeeding Lisa Davis as the carrier scales its US retail and wholesale operations.

headline: Average 401(k) balance hits record high even as more workers tap retirement savings early
summary: Fidelity's latest account data shows the average 401(k) balance rose 13.1% year-over-year to a record $155,800, but the firm also flagged a rising share of savers taking hardship withdrawals or loans amid ongoing financial pressure.

headline: Federal guidance tightens expectations for retirement plan recordkeeping accuracy
summary: A roundup of federal retirement rules highlights sharpened recordkeeping and reporting expectations for plan sponsors and administrators, part of continued fallout from SECURE 2.0 implementation as agencies push for more reliable participant data.

headline: Health Care Administrators Association names its 2026-2027 board of directors
summary: The HCAA, a trade group for self-funded health plan third-party administrators, appointed its board and officers for the 2026-2027 term, naming Professional Benefit Administrators' Jeff Walter as president to lead advocacy and education efforts for the self-funding industry.

headline: Wealth Enhancement adds Virginia RIA in its third second-half deal of the year
summary: Minneapolis-based consolidator Wealth Enhancement acquired the investment advisory business of Dickerson Jackson & Associates, a hybrid RIA in Glen Allen, Virginia managing about $376 million in client assets, continuing its acquisitive pace into the second half of 2026.

headline: Hightower taps data infrastructure startup Dispatch to unify records across its advisory network
summary: Hightower Advisors selected fintech Dispatch to synchronize client data across custodians for its Hightower Signature Wealth channel, which has scaled to roughly $35 billion in assets across 30 locations as the firm consolidates breakaway advisor teams.

headline: Vanguard deepens its push into financial advice with deal to acquire digital RIA platform Altruist
summary: Vanguard, under CEO Salim Ramji, is moving further into financial advice through an agreement to acquire Altruist, seen as an attempt to reshape the RIA custody and advice landscape, though analysts say winning over independent advisors may prove challenging.

headline: Aon to acquire USI Insurance Services for $17 billion, forming a top US middle-market broker
summary: Aon signed a definitive agreement to buy USI Insurance Services from KKR for $17.0 billion, aiming to build the leading platform in the US middle-market segment; the deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026 and follows Aon's 2024 acquisition of NFP.

headline: Mapfre to acquire Safety Insurance Group in a $1.54 billion all-cash deal
summary: Massachusetts-based Safety Insurance agreed to be acquired by an affiliate of Spain's Mapfre for about $1.54 billion, or $105 per share in cash, after Safety reported second-quarter net income of $34.5 million.

headline: Underwriting data emerges as the front line against rising insurance fraud
summary: Industry commentary argues that stronger underwriting-stage data and analytics, not just post-claim fraud detection, are the real fix for persistent fraud losses, citing cases like South African life insurers losing over R131.6 million a year despite heavy compliance spending.

headline: Global insurance supervisors roll out a practical AI-governance toolkit for regulators
summary: The International Association of Insurance Supervisors published member-only 2026 guidance, including a supervisory "question bank," to help national regulators engage with insurers on AI governance and risk management for real-world AI use cases.

headline: UCare to exit the Medicare Advantage market amid rising medical costs
summary: Minnesota nonprofit insurer UCare asked CMS to terminate its Medicare Advantage plans for 2026 and is winding down operations, citing rising medical costs and broader market pressure, with its Medicaid and ACA business being sold to Medica.

headline: Barts Health expands free NHS cholesterol testing to 100 more community pharmacies
summary: Following a successful pilot, Barts Health NHS Trust is expanding free cardiovascular and cholesterol testing to up to 100 additional community pharmacies across England, part of a broader push to catch heart-disease risk earlier outside hospital settings.

headline: UCLH study: many breast-cancer survivors can safely stop heart-protective medication
summary: A study by UCLH, UCL, and Barts Health NHS Trust, presented at the European Society of Cardiology Congress in Munich on September 2, 2026, found that many breast-cancer survivors whose treatment affected heart function can safely stop related medication once their heart recovers, avoiding indefinite treatment.

headline: Insurtech funding accelerates in 2026 as AI-focused deals dominate
summary: Insurtech funding accelerated sharply in 2026, with digital insurance brokers capturing roughly three-quarters of year-to-date funding; CB Insights data shows Q1 2026 alone saw about $1.63 billion raised, with 95% of that flowing to AI-focused companies.

headline: China tightens algorithm-governance expectations for AI-driven insurance pricing and claims
summary: Chinese regulators are pushing insurers toward "algorithm governance," requiring that AI-driven pricing and underwriting models be transparent, explainable, and free of discriminatory bias, while barring insurers from offloading core management responsibility to third-party tech vendors.

headline: Swiss Re Institute: $750 billion AI investment boom is reshaping the insurance risk landscape
summary: Swiss Re Institute says a roughly $750 billion boom in AI-related capital investment, layered on top of geopolitical fragmentation, is reshaping the risks insurers must underwrite and the opportunities available to their investment portfolios.

headline: Swiss Re projects global insurance premium growth will slow sharply to 1.3% in 2026
summary: Swiss Re Institute's latest World Insurance sigma report projects global real premium growth slowing to about 1.3% in 2026 from 3.9% in 2025, with non-life growth nearly flat as pricing competition intensifies and life premiums outperforming the long-term trend.

headline: Target-date fund assets near $5 trillion as providers add guaranteed income and private markets
summary: Target-date fund assets rose more than 20% to roughly $4.8 trillion, according to Morningstar-based analysis, as providers increasingly blend active and passive strategies, embed lifetime-income features, and add private-market exposure to plan defaults.

headline: US annuity sales set a new quarterly record of $123.9 billion in Q2 2026
summary: LIMRA reports total US annuity sales rose 4% year-over-year to a record $123.9 billion in the second quarter of 2026, the eleventh straight quarter above $100 billion, with registered index-linked annuities also setting a quarterly record at $23.3 billion.

headline: US individual life insurance sales grow 3% in Q2 2026 as variable universal life leads
summary: Individual life insurance new annualized premium rose 3% year-over-year in the second quarter of 2026, with variable universal life posting the sharpest growth (up 11% to $800 million) and simplified-issue and final-expense products seeing double-digit policy-count growth among lower- and middle-income buyers.

headline: Casualty lines stay under pressure from "nuclear verdicts" even as property pricing softens
summary: While property insurance pricing eased in the first half of 2026, casualty lines including excess liability, umbrella, and commercial auto remained strained by rising claim severity, large jury verdicts, and medical cost inflation, per the same Verisk/APCIA underwriting report.

headline: Catastrophe bond market on pace for a second straight year above $20 billion in issuance
summary: Cat bond spreads tightened through the summer as issuance accelerated; Aon Securities projects full-year 2026 volume will again top $20 billion, with insurers like Mangrove Property Insurance securing record reinsurance and cat-bond coverage ahead of the Atlantic hurricane season.

headline: EU Council extends EIOPA chair Petra Hielkema's mandate for a second five-year term
summary: The Council of the European Union extended Petra Hielkema's term as chairperson of the European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority for a second five-year term beginning September 1, 2026, following a positive performance review from EIOPA's Board of Supervisors.

headline: RIA dealmaking wave continues as three firms hit AUM milestones in one week
summary: Savant Wealth Management closed its ninth acquisition of the year in New York, F.L. Putnam added a $1 billion Wisconsin advisory team in its 12th deal of the year, and Wealth Enhancement expanded into Virginia — underscoring the record pace of RIA consolidation in 2026.

headline: WealthAi extends its AI "operating system" to independent advisers
summary: WealthAi launched a version of its AI platform aimed at independent and smaller advisory firms, bundling meeting notes, client management, document generation, and compliance into one system; beta trial firms reportedly cut routine client-administration time by 60%.

headline: India's wealth management market on track to grow past $436 billion by 2034
summary: A new market report projects India's wealth management industry will grow at roughly a 10.6% annual rate through 2034, driven by a fast-growing high-net-worth population and a continued shift from physical to financial assets.

headline: US annuity sales hit fresh records as market jitters and rising rates boost demand
summary: InvestmentNews reports war-related uncertainty and Fed rate moves have redrawn fixed-income demand, pushing annuity sales to new highs as insurers see brisk uptake of protected-income products.

headline: LIMRA: US retail annuity sales topped $460 billion in 2025 for a fourth straight record year
summary: LIMRA's year-end tally confirms retail annuity sales crossed $460 billion in 2025 marking a fourth consecutive record year as fixed and indexed products continue gaining share.

headline: US public pension funding hits 85% on strong investment returns despite record contribution burden
summary: Equable Institute's State of Pensions 2026 report finds the average public pension plan is now 85% funded, up from 81.2%, as investment returns beat targets for a fourth straight year, even as employer contribution rates hit a historic high.

headline: MassMutual Ventures doubles down on climate tech with new $150 million fund
summary: MassMutual Ventures launched a second $150 million Climate Technology Fund targeting early-stage companies applying AI and climate tech to energy infrastructure, real estate and natural resources, bringing its total climate commitment to $300 million.

headline: Aquiline to take controlling stake in MassMutual-owned wealthtech platform Flourish
summary: Private equity firm Aquiline Capital Partners agreed to acquire a controlling interest in Flourish, the RIA-focused cash-management and lending platform serving over 1,300 advisors with $2.6 trillion in client assets, with MassMutual remaining a minority investor.

headline: Savant Wealth Management expands into upstate New York with its ninth deal of 2026
summary: Illinois-based Savant Wealth Management, now managing about $56.5 billion, acquired Socha Financial Group, a $542 million Corning-area RIA, marking Savant's ninth acquisition this year and its most active buying pace in the industry.

headline: European wealthtech funding drops 46% in Q2 as investors turn cautious
summary: European wealthtech funding fell to $185.5 million in the second quarter, down 46% quarter-over-quarter, with average deal size dropping 24% as investors grew more selective despite continued deal activity.

headline: Home insurance rates set to rise for a fifth straight year as wildfire and storm losses mount
summary: Insurify projects US homeowners insurance premiums will keep climbing in 2026, with California rates alone forecast to jump 16% as insurers respond to persistent wildfire losses and capital strain.

headline: Lloyd's of London posts £1.9 billion first-half underwriting profit as combined ratio improves
summary: Lloyd's reported an improved first-half 2026 combined ratio of 90.8%, down from 92.5% a year earlier, driving a £1.9 billion underwriting profit even as the market flags rising competitive pressure in reinsurance pricing.

headline: ANV Group acquires wholesale workers' comp specialist Associated Specialty Insurance Agency
summary: Global insurance intermediary platform ANV Group completed its acquisition of Associated Specialty Insurance Agency, a Pennsylvania-based wholesale commercial agency focused on workers' compensation coverage.

headline: Congress enacts sweeping PBM reform, reshaping disclosure duties for TPAs and self-funded plans
summary: New federal pharmacy-benefit-manager reform enacted in early 2026 brings fresh compliance and disclosure obligations for PBMs and third-party administrators working with ERISA self-funded group health plans, employment-law advisors say.

headline: Fintech funding surges past $1.3 billion across a dozen deals in a single week
summary: FinTech Global's weekly tracker recorded more than $1.3 billion raised across 12 deals, with wealthtech and payments firms accounting for the bulk of activity in a notably strong week for the sector.

headline: Insurtech Qumis rolls out AI coverage-analysis agents across 16 commercial lines
summary: Chicago insurtech Qumis launched AI agents that deliver citation-backed coverage analysis in minutes across 16 lines including cyber, D&O and marine, with plans to expand to 100 lines by year-end.

headline: Singapore digital insurer KoverNow secures Hong Kong license and launches local app
summary: KoverNow, a Singapore-headquartered digital insurer specializing in luxury-goods coverage, obtained an insurance intermediary license from Hong Kong's Insurance Authority and launched its mobile app in the market.

headline: InsuranceDekho and RenewBuy merge to form India's largest AI-led insurance distribution platform
summary: The combined entity, operating under the InsuranceDekho brand, has a premium book above Rs 6,600 crore and reaches 98.57% of India's postal codes, pairing InsuranceDekho's north-and-west presence with RenewBuy's southern network.

headline: CVS raises 2026 earnings outlook again as Aetna's insurance recovery accelerates
summary: CVS Health lifted its full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $7.90-$8.10, its second raise this year, as improved medical-cost management at Aetna and strength across its pharmacy and retail segments drove the beat-and-raise quarter.

headline: Bipartisan House bill would bar AI from making final call on health insurance claim denials
summary: Reps. Landsman and Carter introduced the Doctors Not AI Act, which would require a qualified clinician to make medical-necessity denial decisions and permit AI only in a supporting role, alongside new disclosure requirements for its use.

headline: Health systems report major documentation time savings from ambient AI scribes
summary: Intermountain Health cut time spent on visit notes by 27% using Microsoft's Dragon Copilot, while Cooper University Healthcare and a Mercy Missouri nurse reported saving more than an hour of charting per shift, per HIStalk's latest healthcare AI roundup.

headline: Hospital operating margins keep compressing in 2026 despite double-digit revenue growth
summary: HFMA data shows the median health-system operating margin has fallen to a 0.4% year-to-date level in 2026 as labor, drug and supply cost growth outpace revenue gains, even though gross operating revenue rose over 11% year-over-year.
